title: 佩恩。州长夏皮罗表示太多数据中心开发商“不关心我们的社区”
content:
Pennsylvania Gov.Josh Shapirosaid Tuesday that "too many"data centerdevelopers don't care about the communities where they are building those artificial intelligence-sector projects, which have met with growing opposition nationwide.

Shapiro's comments to CNBC's "Squawk on the Street" came a day after PresidentDonald Trumpsaid the only reason American communities should not want AI data centers "is if they want to end up being backwards and poor."

"The reality is, I want CEOs that give a damn about the community where they're going to be," said Shapiro, who appeared on CNBC withChobaniCEOHamdi Ulukayato talk about the Greek yogurt maker's planned $1.2 billion investment in a new Lehigh Valley, Pennsylvania, dairy manufacturing hub.

"Unfortunately, we've seen too many developers who don't care about our communities who are trying to run roughshod over our communities, and those are the kinds of data center projects we don't want here," Shapiro said. "We want to work with people that want to work with local communities."

The governor, who is considered a potential contender for the 2028 Democratic presidential nomination, on Aug. 18 signed anexecutive orderaimed at controlling data center development, mandating that any proposals for centers comply with theGovernor's Responsible Infrastructure Development (GRID) Requirements, and removing all artificial intelligence data center projects from a fast-track approval program.

"This executive order represents the most stringent requirements in the entire country," Shapiro said when he signed the order. "And my word to developers is you better follow these requirements. Otherwise you shouldn't plan to do business here."

Shapiro's order came as he seeks re-election as governor against Republican nominee, state Treasurer Stacy Garrity.

He cited that order during his appearance with Ulukaya on Tuesday.

"That's why I put those regulations in place through my executive order that says you've got to earn local support before you can even come to the state for permitting," Shapiro said. "We want to frankly knock out the people who don't view the world the way Hamdi and Chobani do, that they're partners with the community."

Asked what that means, Shapiro said data center developers have to earn local support before seeking permits from the state.

"Number two, you've got to generate your own power, and you got to pay for the power," he said. "You can't saddle local homeowners and businesses with that. Number three, you've got to protect our water supply and our air quality."

"All of those things are common sense, and you are now legally bound to those standards."

Shapiro is one of several governors who haveimposed new restrictionsor called for greater scrutiny of data center development amid widespread public opposition to the projects, which has become a political flashpoint in the upcoming congressional and state elections.

Opponents toAI data centers, which house computing equipment used to train and operate artificial intelligence models, say they can boost electricity demand and utility costs and strain local water sources.

In June 2025, Shapiro had toutedAmazon's announcement that it would spend at least $20 billion to build two data center complexes in Pennsylvania as the biggest private investment in state history.

"It's important to note that this is just an initial investment coming from Amazon, so this is going to grow," Shapiro told CNBC's "Squawk Box" that month. "Pennsylvania is going to be better off. I think America is going to be better off because we're going to win the battle of AI supremacy and it's going to be done right here in the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania."

Shapiro's challenger, Garrity, in response to his executive order in August, released a video calling it "damage control."

"Josh Shapiro spent the last year rolling out the red carpet for massive data center development in Pennsylvania," Garrity said in the video. "He celebrated it, he promoted it, he said he was proud of it."

Garrity said that if she is elected, "I will pause data center development in Pennsylvania."

But Garrity, in a radio interview a year earlier, had said "Ohio is kicking our butt" in having more than double the number of data centers that Pennsylvania has.

"We could be doing so much more in that space, she said.

AGallupsurvey released in May found that "seven in 10 Americans oppose constructing data centers for artificial intelligence in their local area."

On the same day Shapiro signed his order in August, the National Republican Senatorial Committee issued a memo warning voter backlash to data centers has put Sen. Jon Husted, R-Ohio, at risk of losing a special election to Democratic nominee Sherrod Brown, himself a former senator.

"If Husted loses because of data centers, the industry will be blamed, and elected officials of both parties will learn a cautionary lesson," the NRSC said.

David Sacks, who is co-chair of the President's Council of Advisors on Science & Technology, in a separate interview later Tuesday on "Squawk on the Street," said "there is a good deal to be made here between local communities and data centers and the AI companies."

"You educate the average residential consumer and voter, that actually there's a way for these data centers to bring down their electricity costs," Sacks said.

"That actually the data center operators are willing to fund grid upgrades. That actually data centers don't use a lot of water now because the water recirculates," he said. "When you actually educate them about the issue, the poll numbers change dramatically, and you'll see that a majority of voters will actually support data centers."

title: 美国在新的霍尔木兹海峡航运袭击后袭击伊朗：中央司令部
content:
美国中央司令部在社交媒体帖子中表示，在两艘油轮在关键航线上受到攻击后，美国军方周二对霍尔木兹海峡周围的伊朗目标发动了新的打击。

据报道，唐纳德·特朗普总统正在考虑一项中央司令部计划进行有限攻击，旨在阻止伊朗重建可用于瞄准伊朗船只的雷达和导弹能力。

中央司令部表示，在最近试图袭击霍尔木兹海峡的商业航运和该地区的美国人员后，美国军队于美国东部时间中午开始袭击伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队的目标。该司令部没有立即透露目标的数量或位置，或涉及哪些美国军事资产。

特朗普在周二的《真相社会》中称这次袭击“规模大且威力大”，称这是对伊朗试图在霍尔木兹海峡添加水雷以及对美国驻约旦基地进行导弹袭击的报复。

特朗普还威胁称，如果德黑兰进行报复，伊朗将采取更大规模的回应，称伊朗将采取报复行动。将会受到“更严重、更高级别的打击”，并警告称，一场更大规模的袭击正在“伺机而动”。

伊朗似乎不久后就开始报复。国营塔斯尼姆通讯社报道称，伊朗武装部队针对美国的袭击发起了“果断行动”，并表示美国在该地区的基地和利益将成为伊朗导弹和无人机的目标。

局势升级有可能进一步延长特朗普曾预测将在四个星期内结束的战争，这使得他在 11 月中期选举临近时结束战争的竞选承诺变得更加复杂。据路透社/益普索民意调查周一发布的数据，特朗普的支持率为 33%，而只有 36% 的美国人支持伊朗战争。

此次行动标志着美国和伊朗在大约一个月内首次交火后的新一轮升级。

周日，在中央司令部表示伊朗军队准备发射火箭弹后，美国军方袭击了伊朗拉拉克岛的火箭发射器。携带水雷进入海峡。

德黑兰的回应是向美国在约旦的基地发射导弹，但遭到拦截。阿拉伯联合酋长国还表示，它在其领海拦截了一架伊朗无人机。

特朗普周一威胁要进行进一步报复，他告诉福克斯新闻，“我们将严厉打击他们。将会做出回应。”

美国驻卡塔尔大使馆周二发布安全警报，警告可能出现“不可预见的升级”，并敦促该地区的美国人在航班可能取消的情况下保持高度警惕，空域关闭和其他旅行中断。

这些袭击是华盛顿和德黑兰之间长达数月的霍尔木兹海峡斗争的最新导火索，霍尔木兹海峡是世界上最重要的能源咽喉要道之一。据美国称，战前，全球大约五分之一的石油供应通过该水道。能源信息管理局。

title: 加密货币进入九月，立法政策赌博岌岌可危
content:
The crypto industry heads into September with its biggest legislative bet hanging in the balance, and little confidence the proposed bill will make it past the finish line.

The looming vote on the crypto market structure bill known as the Clarity Act is shaping up as a critical test for an industry that's spent years pushing Washington for clearer rules around digital assets. The bill would establish a framework for crypto, divide oversight between the Securities Exchange Commission and the Commodity Futures Trading Commission, set registration requirements and strengthen anti-money-laundering protections.

But despite efforts by crypto executives and President Donald Trump to excite investors and industry watchers about the possibility that the bill could become law this year, the mood is less optimistic among industry participants.

Many are resigned that the Clarity Act is dead in 2026.

"I personally am a bit pessimistic about the Clarity Act being passed," John Darsie, CEO of SALT, told CNBC at the Wyoming Blockchain Symposium in Jackson Hole in August. "Leading into the midterms, you don't often pass legislation of this magnitude." SALT calls itself an investment and networking platform and leadership forum.

The Clarity Act missed sponsors' legislative window when the Senate adjourned for its August recess without voting on the bill. Now, Senate Majority Leader John Thune has scheduled a key procedural vote for Sept. 15, after the Senate returns from its recess, potentially paving the way for a full floor vote.

Unresolved issues include stablecoin rewards andethics provisions tied to President Trumpand his family's crypto interests. Arizona Sen. Ruben Gallego, one of only two Democrats voting to advance the bill out of the Senate Banking Committee, has been working on a bipartisan compromise regarding ethics language for the Clarity Act. There is still a chance for the bill to advance in the Senate, but Republicans and Democrats need to find consensus, Gallego said.

"The way to get 60 votes is with good ethics legislation as well as rounding out some of the things that are still outstanding," Gallego said during a fireside chat at the Wyoming Blockchain Symposium last month.

The possible demise of Clarity stands in stark relief to the historic sums committed in the 2024 election cycle to shifting Washington's position on crypto. Crypto-backed political groupsspent more than $200 million, helping elect candidates friendly to the industry and making crypto regulation a mainstream issue.

The bet was straightforward: a Trump victory and a more crypto-friendly Washington could replace years of regulatory hostility.

Viewed from a narrow lens, the investment is already paying off, even if Clarity dies. The SEC and CFTC are more accommodating to crypto under Trump, while other regulators – including the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency, a key banking regulator – have also moved toward a looser framework for digital assets.

From the White House, the Trump administration continues to publicly frame crypto policy as a priority. At a cryptocurrency summit in August, President Trump said the administration is focused on creating "a clear regulatory framework for pioneers and builders."

The White House meeting took place at the same time as the Wyoming Blockchain Symposium in Jackson Hole. Industry leaders speaking in Wyoming argued that crypto can continue to develop even without the comprehensive market structures found in Clarity. SEC and CFTC rulemaking can provide more certainty in the absence of Clarity, executives told CNBC, while companies continue building under the more relaxed regulatory framework taking shape.

"We've already seen some contingency planning," said Sunayna Tuteja, former chief innovation officer at the Federal Reserve, pointing to discussions between the SEC and CFTC about what can be done through rulemaking. "Not perfect, but progress nonetheless."

Denelle Dixon, president of Stellar Development Foundation, argued that the industry should use the next two years to improve existing regulations, creating precedent that can survive the next administration. Stellar is a nonprofit that aims to widen access to global finance using blockchain technology.

The next two years should be spent using the rules and standards that have already emerged from the SEC and CFTC so that, "whichever administration takes over, we have all of this bulletproof work that we've done to show not only is it successful, but it is advantageous for us to maintain this market structure," Dixon said.

Accepting today's status quo still leaves the industry pushing for clear rules to reduce uncertainty, provide an upside catalyst for bitcoin and the broader crypto market and make it easier for companies and investors to commit capital.

"If you're looking to deploy capital and invest, and one [jurisdiction] has an established framework while another jurisdiction like the U.S. … may be subject to, every two to four years, rapid and extreme change – [it's] hard to allocate capital," said Andrew McCormick, head of institutional and market development at Chainlink Labs. Formal legislation can provide certainty that survives changes in administrations and political parties, he said.

Former New York Gov. Andrew Cuomo, an OKX board member, warned that if Clarity doesn't pass before the midterm elections, a change in control of the House could produce years of regulatory conflict.OKX provides spot, margin, and derivatives tradingfor digital assets, alongside decentralized finance tools.

"If you believe there's a change of power, at least in the House, which I do believe that Democrats will win the House, then you're going to have a Democratic Congress overseeing an administration, the Trump administration, with the regulators making decisions under the scrutiny of a hostile Congress and that is not a good place to be because Congress will be at loggerheads with the administration," Cuomo told CNBC at the Wyoming Blockchain Symposium.

After years of operating under an often hostile regulatory regime, the industry may simply have learned how to keep moving without Washington providing a definitive framework.

That means that in the current political climate, passing Clarity would count as a major win. But failure may not prove the setback crypto companies once feared.

title: 软银旗下 SB Energy 申请 IPO，称其“严重依赖”OpenAI
content:
由软银、OpenAI 和 Nvidia 支持的人工智能电力基础设施公司 SB Energy 已向美国证券交易委员会提交首次公开募股申请。

在周二提交的文件中列出的风险因素中，SB Energy 表示，它“很大程度上依赖于”OpenAI 作为租户和股权投资者的表现。 OpenAI 首席执行官 Sam Altman 也是该公司的早期个人投资者。

文件中指出，“这种集中意味着我们的近期收入、项目级融资安排和开发计划与 OpenAI 在我们的租赁和相关协议下的持续业绩密切相关。”

根据 SEC 的文件，该公司的数据中心园区严重依赖合作伙伴的外部融资，并且尚未从这部分业务中产生任何收入。 SB Energy 的数据中心尚未投入运营。

2026 年上半年，SB Energy 遭受了约 32 亿美元的净亏损，理由是对其数据中心战略进行了“大量投资”，并在同一时期产生了约 1.39 亿美元的收入，主要来自其传统能源业务。

Nvidia 在 8 月宣布将为 SB 位于俄亥俄州的 OpenAI 数据中心提供 1050 亿美元的融资。能源。

“Nvidia 加入我们的原因是，你知道，它可以帮助我们解锁投资级融资之类的东西。它有助于确保项目取得成功，”首席执行官 Rich Hossfeld 在融资公告后告诉 CNBC 的“Squawk Box”。

该公司将在纳斯达克和纳斯达克德克萨斯州交易，股票代码为 SBE。据《华尔街日报》报道，软银是控股股东。

虽然该公司尚未公布定价或上市的具体时间表，但最快可能于本月开始交易。据《华尔街日报》报道，该公司希望通过此次发行筹集 50 亿至 70 亿美元的资金。

IPO 招股说明书还指出，公众对数据中心日益强烈的抵制是一个风险因素。

“我们可能面临社区反对、当地暂停和超本地异议，包括公众对人工智能和人工智能相关基础设施日益增长的抵制，这可能会对我们的数据中心和发电业务和运营产生不利影响，”文件中写道。

其他风险包括：该公司在 S-1 中披露的技术进步“可能使我们的设施过时或无法销售”、企业未能采用人工智能、监管变化以及超大规模企业的资本支出减速。

OpenAI 的提及次数几乎与软银本身一样多，在 S-1 中出现了 306 次，而软银只出现了 325 次。Nvidia 被提及了 135 次。

title: 10-year yield hits highest since January 2025 as higher oil prices stoke inflation worries
content:
U.S. Treasury yields rose on Tuesday as renewed tensions in the Middle East drove global government borrowing costs to their highest point going back to early last year.

The10-year Treasurynote yield — the main benchmark for mortgages, auto loans and credit card debt — rose 3 basis points to 4.788%. The yield hit its highest level since Jan. 14, 2025 earlier in the day.

The longer-dated30-year Treasurybond yield, which tends to track geopolitical events, was up more than 1 basis point at 5.261%.

The yield on the2-year Treasurynote, which typically moves in line with short-term Federal Reserve interest rate decisions, climbed more than 3 basis points to 4.385%.

One basis point equals 0.01%, or 1/100th of 1%, and yields and prices move inversely to one another.

Borrowing costs reached their highs of the day as traders continued to weighdevelopments in the Middle East. The focus comes after U.S. forces earlier launched fresh strikes against Iran and a tanker was struck by unknown projectiles off the coast of Oman in the Strait of Hormuz.

The escalation pushedoil priceshigher.West Texas Intermediate futureswere last seen 4% higher at above $89 per barrel, whileBrent crude— the international oil price benchmark — advanced 4% to above $94.

"With no clear path to reopening the Strait after six months of war, inflation worries remain elevated. Uncertainty over the Federal Reserve's policy outlook, fiscal concerns, and rising AI-related debt issuance have all kept bonds under pressure," said Ulrike Hoffmann-Burchardi, UBS chief investment officer of the Americas and global head of equities, said in a Tuesday note. "Yield volatility is likely to persist in the near term."

Investors are also monitoring theG20 finance ministers' meetingin Asheville, North Carolina, which is set to conclude later Tuesday, as well as a raft of domestic economic data, with nonfarm payrolls figures expected Friday.

The August reading of the ISM Manufacturing Indexfell 1 point from Julyto 54.6, which was slightly below the 55.3 that economists polled by Dow Jones expected. Meanwhile, job openings in July came in roughly as expected.

title: AI代币价格创历史新低
content:
A closely followed measure ofartificial intelligencetokenprices touched fresh lows this week, the latest sign of deflating prices in an increasingly competitive landscape.

TheLLM Token Expenditure Index, a key gauge of daily prices from intelligence firm Silicon Data, fell to 97 cents on Monday. That marked the index's lowest reading since its creation late last year and has more than halved from the high recorded earlier this summer.

Silicon Data's index tracks the going rate on the market for a large-language model token.

A sharp slide in prices can mean AI model users will need to shell out less to run inquiries on popular chatbots like OpenAI's ChatGPT, Anthropic's Claude orGoogle'sGemini.

But it can be bad news for the companies behind the models. A lower index price can condition consumers to expect lower rates for access to these offerings, resulting in less pricing power for providers.

The recent drop is driven in part by the rise of open-source Chinese models likeMoonshot's Kimi K3that can fetch lower prices than alternatives from leading frontier lab, according to aTuesday postfrom Charles-Henry Monchau, investing chief at Syz Group.

OpenAI announced price cutstwo of its GPT-5.6 AI modelsin late July, while Monchau said other frontier labs have rolled out offerings with "dynamic pricing" capabilities that can allow access rates to rise and fall with demand. These developments put more downward pressure on the market rate for tokens.

"Foundation model labs are the most directly exposed," Monchau wrote. "Token deflation compresses the revenue line while compute commitments stay fixed. The strategic response is visible: the moat must shift away from raw model capability — where the open-weight gap is now measured in months — toward distribution, memory and context."

Decreasing costs across the industry for producing a token have also led to lower prices in the index, Monchau said.

The LLM Token Expenditure Index's slide could put new profit pressures on AI leaders like Anthropic and OpenAI as they contemplate when and if to enter the public market. Both companiesconfidentiallyfiledfor initial public offerings with regulators this summer.

Investors may also need to rejigger their outlooks around the potential return on invested capital in the AI buildout as token prices slide. Megacap technology companies includingNvidiaandMicrosofthave poured billions of dollars into plans to expand their capabilities to power AI.

Technology stocksled the broader market downon Tuesday. The technology-heavyNasdaq Compositeslid nearly 1%, while the broaderS&P 500ticked down 0.4%.

— CNBC's Nick Robertson contributed to this report.

title: 加拿大卡尼批评特朗普政府“搞表情包……遮羞”
content:
加拿大总理马克·卡尼永周二抨击特朗普政府在日益激烈的贸易战中“搞表情包”并为加拿大“蒙上阴影”。

卡尼的评论是针对记者提出的关于特朗普官员在社交媒体帖子和评论中嘲笑加拿大军方以及唐纳德·特朗普总统签署一项行政命令，指示联邦政府将安大略湖更名为“美国湖”的问题做出的回应。总理表示，“与美国之间一直存在着一个积极的机会，可以达成一项尊重加拿大主权的互惠互利的贸易协议”，并尊重加拿大保护和促进魁北克文化和法语的权利。

“当美国人停止做模因，停止投下阴影，停止试图强硬并开始认真进行这些讨论时，我们就可以进行这些关于贸易的讨论”，卡尼在渥太华。

“但是你看，这不是建设性的，但这就是他们的民主。”

当被问及特朗普内阁部长侮辱加拿大军方的问题时，卡尼还表示，“这有失他们的职责”。

总理发表此番言论的前一天，美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特在 20 国集团 (G20) 财长会议上接受 CNBC 采访时嘲笑了加拿大及其军队。北卡罗来纳州阿什维尔。

在那次采访中，当被问及市场是否想知道美国是否正在与加拿大进行“针锋相对的贸易战”时，贝森特回答说，“嗯，我认为你不能与比你大 13 倍的人进行针锋相对。”

“我认为卡尼总理把这变成了……一场政治争吵，这是非常不幸的。”贝森特说。

“我的意思是，我们没有与加拿大交战。我们如何与加拿大交战呢？”财政部长问道。 “什么，他们要从埃德蒙顿购物中心拿走两艘潜艇来攻击我们？”

周一晚上，美国国防部长皮特·赫格斯在 X 上发布了一条消息，上面有加拿大国旗表情符号，上面有一张女学员在弗农学员培训中心从女教官手中接过奖章的照片，上面写着“（这是真的）”。 该培训中心是为加拿大青少年开设的。

这条推文被回复这篇文章的用户广泛认为是 Hegseth 对教练进行身体羞辱。

“哇。国防部长是对身体羞辱的学员团体。一个青年团体。这不是一个军事单位。他们是寻求冒险、测试自己并与服务价值观保持一致的孩子，”自称是加拿大退伍军人的 X 用户丹尼·奥里根 (Danny O'Reagan) 写道。 “不要成为皮特。”

美国自8月下旬两国贸易谈判破裂以来，加拿大官员一直在进行口水战。

美国于8月22日对部分价值200亿美元的加拿大进口商品征收50%的关税。

三天后，加拿大表示将对700多种美国商品征收15%至50%的关税，所谓的“美元对美元”匹配关于美国的关税。这些报复性关税将于 9 月 8 日生效。

title: 由于通胀担忧，美国借贷成本再创新高
content: 图片来源，Getty Images作者：Michael RaceBusiness记者，纽约报道3小时前发布 由于中东新一轮罢工推高油价并加剧对通胀的担忧，美国借贷成本周二再创新高。随着油价飙升至每桶92美元上方，10年期借贷实际利率升至4.79%，为2025年1月以来最高水平。全球债券市场的此类变动影响了美国的利率政府可以借钱，但也会影响人们支付抵押贷款、汽车贷款和信用卡的利率。借贷成本的飙升以及对美国物价上涨速度的担忧，导致人们越来越多地猜测美联储将在本月晚些时候加息。美国央行行长迈克尔·巴尔(Michael Barr)周二在一次讲话中表示，五年来通胀一直过高，并警告称，如果通胀不降温，“那么我认为我们应该果断采取行动加息”。他的评论是在主席凯文·沃什(Kevin Warsh)之后发表的。美联储上周表示，如果政策制定者对美国人的生活成本压力缓解没有信心，他们将“有工作要做”。最新数据显示，截至7月份的一年中，物价上涨了3.4%，高于美联储2%的目标，但利率已连续数月保持在3.5%至3.75%之间。沃什对潜在的加息路径仍然守口如瓶，但投资者最近几天一直在关注言论和加息预期。本月的通胀率有所上升。通货膨胀令美联储和全球投资者都忧心忡忡，这推动了债券市场利率（或众所周知的收益率）的上涨。政府出售债券（本质上是借条）以筹集支出资金，并支付利息作为回报。如果通胀较高或预计未来通胀率会升高，债券投资者通常会要求更高的回报或收益率，而此类利率往往会决定世界各地经济体的借贷成本。除了通胀之外，投资者还担心通胀金额从世界各国政府借款以及大型科技公司的支出，人工智能的投资回报仍存在不确定性。在美国，国债已突破 40 万亿美元大关，在唐纳德·特朗普和乔·拜登政府的十年内翻了一番。在借贷成本超过 30 年来达到 2007 年以来的最高水平后，财政部长斯科特·贝森特表示，美国政府将回购更多债务，以降低利率，但市场对债务的反应公告被证明是短暂的。在债券市场飙升之后，美国 30 年期抵押贷款利率已升至近 6.7% 的一年高位。利率上升可能会降低借贷和支出的吸引力，如果消费者削减开支和企业停止投资，则可能会抑制经济增长。相关主题美联储通胀美国经济美国

title: 美联储理事巴尔表示，如果通胀不缓解，他将支持加息
content:
Federal Reserve Governor Michael Barr said Tuesday he would be prepared to support an interest rate hike if inflation doesn't ease.

Speaking at a banking forum in Washington, the policymaker said he's concerned about "broader price pressures taking hold" as inflation has remained stuck above the Fed's 2% target for nearly 5½ years.

"If trends in the data give me some confidence that inflation is moderating on a path to 2%, then I think we can take a bit more time to assess our policy stance," Barr said in prepared remarks. "However, if inflation appears not to be moderating sufficiently, then I think we should act decisively to raise rates."

The comments come at a critical time for policy and the broader backdrop of elevated inflation andrising Treasury yields. As a governor, Barr is a permanent voting member on the rate-setting Federal Open Market Committee.

Amid fresh worries over the precarious Middle East situation, yields jumped again Tuesday, with the benchmark10-year noteat a level not seen since mid-January 2025.

At the same time, Fed ChairmanKevin Warshlast weekdelivered remarksthat markets widely interpreted as titled toward a rate hike, possibly as soon as the next policy meeting in two weeks. Barr supported theJuly decisionto keep the benchmark funds rate targeted between 3.5%-3.75%, but markets Tuesday morning were pricing in about a 66% chance of an increase this month, according to the CME Group'sFedWatchtool.

Barr gave the economy good marks even with elevated inflation.

"Consumer spending to date has been largely resilient," he said. "But inflation remains too high — and has been for over five years," he said.

The most recentinflation readingsshowed headline prices up 3.7% over the past year, or 3.3% excluding food and energy. The Fed will get one more look at inflation data when the consumer and producer price indexes are released next week.

title: 丰田混合动力 RAV4 需求旺盛，经销商等待更多供应
content:
丰田汽车公司遇到了一个汽车制造商罕见的问题：对其新款 RAV4 的需求如此之大，而库存却如此有限，以至于经销商只能有几天的供应。

“看到汽车像这样从经销商的仓库里飞走，真的很不寻常，”Edmunds 产品洞察主管杰西卡·考德威尔 (Jessica Caldwell) 说。 “这不是那种非常实用、非常郊区的中小型跨界车细分市场中存在的东西。”

在康涅狄格州米尔福德的殖民丰田，由于缺乏 RAV4，车主鲍比·克拉布特里 (Bobby Crabtree) 在他的经销店里留下了几个新车位。

“这个停车场可以容纳另外 250 辆车，所以我可能已经满了这个容量的三分之一，”克拉布特里一边看着数十辆新车和二手车一边说道。丰田汽车。

正常情况下，并非所有这些空地都会停满新的 RAV4，但肯定会有更多，他说。

丰田的 RAV4 在过去几年中一直是炙手可热的车型，去年在美国的销量接近 48 万辆。根据 Cox Automotive 的数据，它是 2025 年美国第三畅销车型，仅次于福特 F-150 和雪佛兰索罗德这两款全尺寸皮卡，这两款皮卡多年来一直是最畅销的。

当丰田宣布将推出新版 RAV4 时，有两件事引人注目。首先，跨界多功能车只能作为混合动力车出售。二是先限产后稳步增产。换句话说，经销商不会正常分配新 RAV4。

这并没有阻止像康涅狄格州丹伯里的 Nancy 和 Ira Berman 这样的买家。当他们在 3 月份订购 RAV4 时，他们知道要等一段时间才能拿到新的 SUV。

“等待有点令人烦恼，”南希·伯曼 (Nancy Berman) 说。 “这并没有阻止我们继续这样做，因为我们确实还有其他丰田汽车可供驾驶。”

下订单六个月后，伯曼夫妇很快就会得到他们的新款 RAV4。

对于丰田来说，向全混合动力 RAV4 系列的转变是因为汽油价格居高不下，越来越多的买家开始转向这些类型的汽车。根据 J.D. Power 的数据，到 2026 年，美国销售的汽车中超过 18% 是混合动力汽车，仍然远远落后于 75% 的内燃机汽车，但高于 7% 的纯电动汽车。

由于经销商无法库存新款 RAV4，而客户被告知他们必须等待数周甚至数月才能买到车辆，这引发了丰田是否会失去销量的问题。到目前为止，截至7月，丰田2026年美国销量仍增长0.3%。考虑到 RAV4 的吸引力，考德威尔表示经销商供应有限的影响可能有限。

“丰田产品线中还有其他车辆可供消费者购买，”考德威尔说。 “丰田有很高的品牌忠诚度，购买丰田汽车的人通常会在丰田汽车呆很多年，不仅仅是购买一辆汽车，而是购买多辆汽车。”

title: 宜家降价以吸引现金短缺的顾客
content: 图片来源，盖蒂图片社 图片说明，宜家正试图通过在伦敦开设这样的高街商店来赢得新客户 作者：Emer Moreau 商业记者 31 分钟前发布 瑞典家具巨头宜家正在降低一系列在欧洲受欢迎的产品的价格，包括 Billy 书柜和 Kallax 储物单元，以吸引现金短缺的客户。宜家在过去两年中收入下降，因为生活成本上升降低了人们的投资能力新家具和家居装修。该公司在降价上花费了 12 亿欧元（10 亿英镑），这意味着某些产品的降价幅度高达 28%。宜家表示，它可以通过在整个供应链中节省包装成本来实现降价。负责经营大部分宜家欧洲门店的特许经营商 Ingka 表示，降价“不是一项活动或短期活动”。“这是为了在人们需要时让宜家变得更实惠”大多数，即使这意味着接受较低的利润，”Ingka 首席执行官 Juvencio Maeztu 表示。 “生活成本不断增加，对许多人来说变得越来越艰难。”他补充道：“对许多人来说，家就是合租房屋中的卧室，提供存储和井然有序的解决方案更为重要。”近年来，宜家多次降价，尽管这在最近的财报中对该公司的收入和利润造成了打击。 图片来源，盖蒂图片社 图片说明，宜家广受欢迎的比利书柜是降价的产品之一。具体削减量因国家而异。针对英国客户的降价包括 Kallax 搁架单元从 60 英镑降价至 49 英镑，Billy 书柜降价 10 英镑至 25 英镑。宜家还试图通过在伦敦牛津街和布莱顿丘吉尔广场等中心地区开设较小的商店来吸引新客户。2024 年，宜家推出了自己的二手在线市场，以与 eBay 和 Facebook Marketplace 等网站竞争。根据欧盟数据，由于对通货膨胀和生活成本的担忧，欧洲消费者信心处于近三年来的最低水平。与此同时，在中东休战之后，英国消费者对经济和自己的财务状况变得更加乐观，但分析师警告称，通货膨胀和生活成本上升可能会在未来几个月削弱消费者的信心。宜家在全球范围内以特许经营体系经营着 500 多家商店。其许多极简主义、自行组装的产品已经在欧洲各地的家庭中无处不在。但它因助长一次性家具和过度包装文化而受到环保人士的批评。相关主题宜家生活成本公司零售消费者行为更多关于这个故事从照明到复古宝石：美化你的租金的五种方法发布5天前

title: 随着人工智能挑战和内存紧缩加剧，苹果进入约翰·特努斯时代
content:
When incomingAppleCEO John Ternus spoke to CNBC in late 2023, he was all about the technology. Custom chips, device battery life and memory architecture were among his primary interests.

"If we build the right products with the right components within them, right silicon and other technologies, people love them," Ternus, who took over as head of hardware two years earlier, said in theinterview.

Ternus' job gets a whole lot bigger on Tuesday, when he succeedsTim Cookand becomes just the second CEO of Apple since Steve Jobs left in 2011, shortly before his death. The 25-year company veteran will be responsible for everything from software and devices to finance and legal, while also having to articulate a vision for a $4.7 trillion company that hasn't yet fully executed its strategy in artificial intelligence.

Apple representatives have said the transition from the 65-year-old Cook to the 51-year-old Ternus will be "thoughtful" and "smooth." Ternus said, when thesuccession was announced in April, that he would carry on Apple's "values and vision."

That was in a statement. Investors and customers have heard almost nothing from him in real life since then, as Cook has remained the public face of the company, even on the lastearnings calla month ago. Ternus hardly made an appearance on the call, and when asked directly by an analyst about the competitive landscape, he responded by saying he would "reiterate what Tim said."

"There is so much opportunity for us with everything that's happening in this space," Ternus said. "We're just really focused on our plans and very excited about it."

Ternus will have one big luxury that wasn't afforded Cook at the time of his promotion. Cook isn't leaving the company, but is stepping into the role of executive chairman and will continue to engage with "policymakers around the world," among other duties, according to the April statement. He's a critical ally for Ternus as Apple contends with a global memory crisis that's forcing the company toincrease priceson consumer gadgets while Americans are wrestling with stubborn inflation.

On his last day at the helm, Cook said he's "excited for the next chapter."

"My title changes tomorrow, but the love I have for the Apple community never will,"Cook wrote in a post on Xon Monday.

His exit presents a tough balancing act for Apple when it comes to who is seen as the person guiding the ship, said Kathy Gersch, CEO of Kotter, a consulting firm focused on leadership changes and transitions. Ternus is tasked with convincing shareholders, employees and customers that he can lead the company into the future and that he's not just doing what the old boss would do.

"What worked for Tim Cook is not going to be the same that works for John Ternus," Gersch said in an interview. "The company is in a new environment. It's going to have to keep evolving and competing."

The first time much of the world will get to know Ternus is on Sept. 9, at Apple's annual launch event, where the company isexpected to unveil new iPhones and Apple Watches. Cook followed in Jobs' footsteps, taking the stage for every major Apple product launch, which garners headlines and millions of viewers around the world.

In June, Apple announced price increases on MacBooks and iPads due to the memory crunch, which is being driven by insatiable demand for AI chips and servers. The company hasn't yet hiked prices for iPhones, though many analysts expect such an announcement will be coming very early in Ternus' tenure.Cook told the Wall Street Journal, shortly before the announcement about MacBooks and iPads, that Apple would have to pass higher costs on to customers.

It's not a short-term problem. The supply shortage for memory and components shows few signs of abating, signaling that gadgets may be more expensive going forward, permanently changing demand patterns and competition.

Meanwhile, the generative AI boom has pushed other companies like OpenAI andSpaceXto explore new computing devices, whileMetaandGoogleare advancing their efforts insmart glasses, all raising questions about whether smartphones will someday be replaced.

Apple's stock is up about 17% so far in 2026, outpacing most of its mega-cap peers, thanks to a strong device cycle and market share gains over Android rivals that are having a harder time coping with memory scarcity. Still, some analysts worry that rising device prices will cover up sluggish unit sales, a shortfall that would eventually show up in other key areas like Apple's services division.

"If growth is coming from volume, that is great," Brandon Nispel, an analyst at KeyBanc and one of the very few on Wall Street who recommends selling the stock, said in an interview. "Investors don't pay a premium for growth coming from price increases because it's not sustainable."

In addition to higher prices for hardware, Apple hasraised pricesonApple TVand Apple One, a bundle subscription that also includes iCloud storage, Apple Music and other services. And some analysts predict thatApple's folding phoneexpected this fall could costas much as $2,500.

Ternus' hardware expertise and his decades spent hiring engineering talent could be a boon for Apple as it enters a potentially new era of devices, said Gene Munster, managing partner at Deepwater Asset Management.

"They went with a product person, and I think that's important," Munster said. In the next couple years, Munster said, Ternus needs to "light up recruiting and bring in awesome talent, because they still need to reinvent themselves."

Apple released some new products during Cook's tenure, such as AirPods and the Apple Watch, but nothing that revolutionized the industry. Its mixed-reality headset, Vision Pro, hasn't sold well.

The company is working on smart home gadgets, robots, AirPods with AI cameras, and other new categories of devices, according to reports as well as snippetsrecently foundin a beta version of MacOS. For Ternus to be successful, he's likely going to need some big new hits.

It's a challenge he's been pondering for years, and one he talked about with CNBC in 2023.

"From the very beginning, we're thinking about how are all these pieces going to come together to make the best possible product for our customers," he said.

title: 20,000 美元以下的二手车往往卖得很快，但买家需要权衡取舍
content:
仍然有可能找到价格低于 20,000 美元的二手车，但买家可能需要比过去做出更大的权衡。

根据汽车公司 Edmunds 的数据，2026 年第二季度，约 32% 的二手车销量为 20,000 美元以下的车辆，比 2019 年同一季度的 55.2% 大幅下降。研究网站。

价格越低，车辆销售得越快：根据数据显示，一辆价值 5,000 美元至 10,000 美元的二手车在经销商拍卖上平均花费 25.4 天，而价格为 20,000 美元至 25,000 美元的二手车则为 37.8 天，价格超过 50,000 美元的二手车则为 44.3 天。埃德蒙兹。

汽车专家表示，这些趋势表明，在汽车通胀和美国整体经济高通胀的背景下，消费者正在寻找更实惠的汽车。

当然，较低的价格只是衡量汽车价值的一个指标。专家表示，消费者可能需要权衡车龄和里程等因素以及潜在的昂贵维修和保养费用。

Edmunds 消费者洞察分析师 Joseph Yoon 表示：“一般来说，价格较低的汽车会比以前更旧，行驶里程也比以前更多。”Edmunds 消费者洞察分析师 Joseph Yoon 表示。

根据考克斯汽车公司 (Cox Automotive) 的数据，7 月份二手车的平均标价为 27,028 美元。总体而言，上个月二手车价格比 Covid-19 大流行之前的 2019 年 7 月高出约 29%，根据消费者价格指数，大致相当于当时美国的总体通胀率。

“今天的二手车价格是消费者面临的负担能力挑战的最有力的例子之一，”二手车研究公司 iSeeCars 的执行分析师 Karl Brauer 表示。

对于买家来说，同样重要的是要记住，购买相对较旧的二手车可能会带来额外的费用，他说。

“一般来说，购买较旧的二手车意味着前期成本较低，但售后维护和维修成本较高。”Brauer 说。

价格范围为 15,000 美元至 20,000 美元的二手车平均车龄为 6 年，并且有据埃德蒙兹称，截至今年第二季度，行驶里程为 71,192 英里。 相比之下，2019 年同一季度的汽车平均车龄仅为 3.4 年，行驶里程为 41,851 英里。

Edmunds 表示，售价 10,000 美元至 15,000 美元的汽车平均车龄今年为 8.7 年，高于 2019 年的 4.7 年。今年汽车的平均行驶里程为 98,222 英里，高于 58,250 英里。

尹说：“即使汽车总体上很可靠，但东西还是会磨损。”

专家表示，除了维护和修理成本可能较高之外，二手车贷款利率通常高于新车贷款利率。

2026 年第二季度，二手车的平均利率根据信用报告公司 Experian 的报告，二手车贷款约为 11.2%，平均贷款期限为 5.6 年。

相比之下，Experian 报告显示，新车的平均贷款利率低得多，为 6.4%，平均贷款期限为 5.7 年。

当然，新车贷款通常比二手车购买者的贷款金额要大。根据 Experian 的数据，第二季度买家为新车融资的平均金额为 43,610 美元，每月支付 765 美元。

与此同时，二手车买家的平均融资金额为 27,852 美元，平均每月支付 542 美元。根据 Experian 的数据，大约三分之一的二手车贷款的付款金额低于 400 美元。

汽车贷款的利率至少部分取决于买家的信用评分。

信用评分越低，买家有资格获得的利率就越高，这意味着在贷款期限内支付更多的利息。根据 Experian 的说法，信用评分较低（低于 500 分）的买家为二手车贷款支付的平均利率超过 21%。

此外，Yoon 表示，潜在买家在确定贷款期限时应考虑汽车的可能使用寿命。

“如果您购买一辆使用了 7 年的二手车，并申请了六年或七年的汽车贷款，然后在贷款三到四年后，您就会发生灾难性的事情。如果你需要更换汽车，你将欠下一大笔贷款，或者必须将其转入你下一辆车的[贷款]，”尹说。

title: 得益于 TikTok 和 Whatnot 等应用，直播购物在美国日益流行
content:
From a warehouse just north of Chicago, Sarah Potempa – celebrity hairstylist and CEO of the viral Beachwaver hair curling iron – keeps thousands of viewers hooked for hours selling products on TikTok live.

This kind of livestream shopping, which has boomed in China over the past decade, is building momentum in the U.S. thanks to social media giant TikTok and live commerce platform Whatnot, which just reached a$20 billion valuation.

Beachwaver did about $8,000 in sales during the first four hours of a TikTok livestream in late July, which CNBC sat in for. She auctioned off limited-edition curling irons as her teenage son DJed behind her; demoed hair care products; and promised viewers she would shave her brother-in-law's head live on camera if they sold 500 orders.

It was one of hundreds of livestreamed shows that Beachwaver does each year. About a quarter of its $1 million in TikTok Shop sales so far in 2026 originated from livestreams, where the company hosts its own selling shows and works with affiliate creators on the popular social media app.

Reminiscent of the QVC craze of the past few decades, livestream shopping puts consumers in front of hosts who sell products in real time.

Now, QVC is live on TikTok for more than 200 hours per week across seven channels, according to the company, as itprioritizes digitalafter recently emerging from bankruptcy.

"QVC is a great example of a large established retailer that might have been seen as a competitor to TikTok shop … but in fact they have turned out to be a really successful merchant," said Patrick Nommensen, president of strategic initiatives for TikTok Shop in the Americas.

Beachwaver got its start on QVC. TikTok and Whatnot have reinvented the wheel.

"Nobody is saying, OK, you have 10 minutes at 7 p.m. and get ready and here's your 10 minutes and you're done," said Potempa. "You definitely need to be on longer on a digital platform, but you really are more in control of the revenue."

The U.S. live shopping industry is forecasted to reach nearly $20 billion in sales in 2026, about 35% higher year-over-year, according to eMarketer industry estimates.

Still, it's a far cry from the rapid growth that live shopping experienced in China.

Alibaba introducedTaobao Live in Chinain 2016. Within five years, the market crossed $50 billion, and it's projected to top $1.1 trillion in 2026, according to eMarketer.

Live shopping has been increasingly integrated into Chinese "super apps," which areutilized by millions of usersand combine features like social media andmessaging in the case of WeChat or AI assistance, food delivery and travel bookingon Alibaba's Qwen.

"[Chinese consumers] still like stores, but they use the livestream part of the digital experience as the entertainment, the engagement, the inspiration," said Globaldata managing director Neil Saunders. "In the U.S., we've tended to rely traditionally more on stores to fulfill that role."

Saunders said that's changing now as younger consumers lean more into live commerce to discover products.

TikTok Shop launched in 2023. The company shared exclusively with CNBC that live shopping sales more than doubled in the first half of 2026 compared to the same timeframe in 2025.

The number of live shopping sessions increased by more than 60% during the same period, TikTok said, and total Live hours grew by more than 80%.

Founded in 2019, Whatnot built its audience on novelties and collectibles. It's grown rapidly over the past year,doubling its valuation since October.Whatnot rankedNo. 8on this year'sCNBC Disruptor 50list, which identifies the most promising venture-backed companies.

Whatnot says it's the largest live shopping platform in the U.S. but declined to share its domestic sales figures. The company told CNBCthat a majorityof the$8 billion in global salesit reported for 2025 were in the U.S.

"You can have [5,000], 10,000 people on Whatnot or TikTok watching your show at one time," said Eric Pagan, who sells for brands on both platforms, during an interview in mid-August. "I did a show on TikTok this weekend that was well into six figures … I think what brands are not aware of yet is that that exists."

Whatnot's core focus is auctions, where viewers can bid on products in real time. TikTok rolled out live auctions in January.

"It feels like things are really, really clicking and live shopping is becoming a bit more mainstream," said Whatnot's Chief Revenue Officer Armand Wilson. "In year one, it was largely all collectibles … Now pretty much anyone can download Whatnot and find something for them."

Legacy online marketplaces likeAmazon,WalmartandeBayalso have native platforms for sellers to host live shopping streams, though those platforms aren't as inherently video-first as social media sites.

Amazon and Walmart declined to comment about their live shopping businesses, while a representative for eBay Live described the offering as making shopping "more human." All three companies declined to share livestream sales figures with CNBC.

Mark Yuan, a former business development lead for eBay's live shopping division and now the owner of e-commerce consulting company And Luxe, said legacy marketplaces benefit from the consumer trust that comes with how long they have been around.

"Those are the things you can't buy with money, but unfortunately, what gives them the advantage also might be their barriers as well," he said. "Structurally it's very hard to transform themselves into a discovery-first or content-first [platform]."

Where newer entrants are succeeding is in creating forums for like-minded consumers.

Whatnot, which is especially popular for collectibles, says it prioritizes community and has seen success in areas like Funko Pop figurines, Pokemon cards, sneakers and fashion.

"Going into a community, really deeply understanding their problems and building a product around them has been the ethos that I think has gotten us to where we are today and what really differentiates us" said Wilson.

Pagan, the livestream host, said without the trust of your viewers, "there is no point in even being live."

"Those people are my friends," he added. "I believe that they know things about me that a normal person on the street wouldn't know. And we had those conversations on a livestream."

Marshal Cohen, chief retail analyst at Circana, said livestream shopping helps to bridge the gap between e-commerce and traditional retail.

"You can't touch and feel the product, but you can hear from others what they think about it," said Cohen. "[Live shopping] bridges that shortfall of the inability to touch and feel. And that's always been online's biggest challenge."

But the platforms have their own set of challenges. Whatnot and TikTok have had to contend with issues ofcounterfeitandstolen goods.

For the sellers, leveraging a large platform comes at a cost:Whatnot takes a commission fee of between 4% and 8%of sales depending on the product, andTikTok takes 6%— plus additional payment processing fees.

And, the growing popularity of live shopping has made it harder to compete for eyeballs.

"The biggest challenge really is visibility," said Globaldata's Saunders. "You have to make sure that your feed is aligned with the algorithm and that it's putting you in front of the right people."

title: OneRail 与 Nvidia 合作推出人工智能平台，帮助零售商更快地做出交付决策
content:
据 CNBC 报道，物流公司 OneRail 正在推出一个使用 Nvidia 人工智能软件的平台，帮助零售商更快地做出最高效的大规模配送选项决策。

这个名为 OmniStar 的新平台允许零售商使用人工智能来评估其所有配送选项，并利用 OneRail 的专有数据为每个订单确定最佳选项。

这家最后一英里配送公司告诉 CNBC，新平台将允许规模较小的公司在扩大规模并提高利润率，以便与包括亚马逊和沃尔玛在内的世界零售巨头竞争。

随着电子商务的发展，零售商必须跟上不断增长的需求并投资于灵活的供应链以优化效率。但这些手动流程通常分散在零售商和物流企业中。

“如果你没有能力做出闪电般的快速决策，你就会放弃利润，”OneRail 首席执行官比尔·卡塔尼亚 (Bill Catania) 告诉 CNBC。 “最后一英里的履行成本很高。”

以前为包裹选择最佳路线可能需要 20 分钟，OneRail 表示，其平台利用人工智能可以在两分半钟内完成。卡塔尼亚说，节省的时间意味着零售商可以运营更大、更快、更精确的供应链。

“这就是人工智能的用武之地。它可以极其迅速地做出此类决策，因此，要做到这一点，Nvidia 硬件和软件就可以发挥作用，真正让这个东西大规模发挥作用。”OneRail 人工智能主管 David Daeschler 说。

Daeschler 表示，该公司三年前开始与 Nvidia 合作探索Nvidia 副总裁兼零售和消费包装产品总经理 Azita Martin 表示：“结果是一个实时决策层，可以以正确的成本将订单发送到正确的承运商和交付模式，而不是依赖静态规则或手动规划。”

Catania 表示，OneRail 的专有数据包括超过 1200 万司机和超过 1000 个物流合作伙伴的网络， Daeschler 表示：“这是为了他们和我们的利益：我们运营更高效。他们节省资金并提供更好的客户体验。”该公司告诉 CNBC，其平台已经在一些客户中部署，其中包括一家大型轮胎分销商，OmniStar 在三年内为公司节省了 4000 万美元的运行费，因为它能够更多地利用其资源

据估计，第四季度该平台的商品总量将超过 60 亿美元。

Nvidia 的 Martin 表示，该平台将使零售商能够更快地做出决策。

“对于零售商来说，更大的价值是能够评估更多场景，根据情况变化更快地做出响应，并在不牺牲服务的情况下提高交付经济效益，”Martin 说。

OneRail 表示，该平台可以帮助小型零售商在交付速度上更有效地竞争

今年早些时候，OneRail 宣布与联邦快递 (FedEx) 建立合作伙伴关系，为所有客户提供当日送达服务，加入零售商的竞争，努力为客户提供最佳、最快的送达选择。卡塔尼亚补充道，这种合作关系现在也将使 OneRail 能够更好地与小型企业合作。

“我们在交付方面所做的事情就像 ChatGPT 和 Anthropic 在文字方面所做的那样 - 一切都是一样的，”Daeschler 说。 “它们为人们提供了更多获取知识的机会。我们让人们能够以负担得起的方式进行交付......这一切都是基于原始模型，根据我们拥有的数据进行培训来完成的，就像互联网上的文字一样。”

title: Tehran urges return to June deal, oil prices rise as Trump vows to hit Iran 'hard'
content:
周二，随着美国和伊朗军事打击的恢复以及霍尔木兹海峡的进一步动荡，交易员们考虑到局势升级的威胁，油价周二延续涨势。

英国海事贸易运营机构在亚洲时间周二的一篇帖子中表示，一艘油轮周一在通过霍尔木兹海峡时被三枚不明弹丸击中。

这艘油轮当时正在航行。英国贸易组织表示，在靠近阿曼海岸的南部航道上发生了袭击，并补充说，没有人员伤亡的报道。

伊朗周一对美国在约旦的两个基地发动了袭击，以报复美国袭击其拉拉克岛。美国军队周日瞄准了拉拉克岛的两架伊朗火箭发射器，据报道造成三人死亡，称德黑兰打算向霍尔木兹海峡发射携带水雷的火箭。

这座位于霍尔木兹海峡的小岛一直是伊朗军队的重要军事和航运控制点，帮助他们牢牢控制通过世界上最重要的海上航线之一的船只交通。

伊朗总统马苏德·佩泽什基安 (Masoud Pezeshkian) 告诉记者据伊朗学生通讯社报道，周二在上海合作组织峰会上，如果华盛顿同意恢复其在 6 月签署的临时协议下的承诺，德黑兰将立即做出回应。

来回的敌对行动标志着美国和伊朗在一个多月内首次进行攻击。

虽然双方似乎都没有寻求恢复全面战争，但双方都表示准备对进一步的袭击做出回应。美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周一对福克斯新闻表示，“我们将严厉打击他们”，并表示将对伊朗袭击美国在该地区的军事基地做出回应。

分析人士普遍认为，美国对拉拉克岛的袭击是打破僵局的一次尝试，而不是战略的转变。国际危机组织副项目主任阿里·瓦埃兹表示：“通过打击发射器而不是更广泛的伊朗军事基础设施，美国似乎是在惩罚特定行为，而不是扩大其战争目标，至少目前是这样。”反核伊朗联盟政策总监杰森·布罗德斯基表示，“美国正在实施封锁。”他补充说，特朗普政府的目标是进一步削弱德黑兰在霍尔木兹海峡布雷的能力，同时集中精力随着中期选举的临近，华盛顿加大了压力，通过“二次制裁”来惩罚购买伊朗原油的国家和企业，以挤压伊朗已经陷入困境的经济。美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特周一在二十国集团财长会议间隙表示，伊朗正在“猛烈抨击”，因为新的制裁正在对其经济造成损害。

据报道，特朗普周一在椭圆形办公室发表讲话称，伊朗的金融体系、武装部队和管理机构已大幅退化。总统说：“这并不意味着我们不会打击他们，看看会发生什么。”

战争现已进入第七个月，扰乱了全球能源供应，并给全球金融市场带来了冲击。由于敌对行动再度升级，国际石油基准布伦特原油价格飙升至每桶 90 美元以上，截至美国东部时间周二凌晨 2:17，最新交易价格为 91.35 美元。美国西德克萨斯中质原油期货上涨 1.07%，至每桶 86.68 美元。

布罗德斯基表示，“这从根本上来说是一场耐力赛”，因为特朗普表现出的“不可预测性”应该引起伊朗人的担忧，而随着经济压力的增加，德黑兰可能会采取更积极的军事打击。

title: 在美国对俄罗斯石油征收关税威胁之际，印度总理莫迪要求普京结束乌克兰战争
content:
印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪周一在上海合作组织峰会期间与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京会面时敦促俄罗斯结束乌克兰战争并停止敌对行动。

“印度支持该地区[乌克兰战争]的所有和平努力，我们将继续这样做，”莫迪说，并补充道，“我们必须从无休止的战争走向终结莫迪说：“战争每持续一天，人类就倒退一步。”

周一，俄罗斯国防部表示，在对弹药仓库发动毁灭性袭击几天后，俄罗斯正计划对乌克兰的能源基础设施进行“大规模袭击”，加剧了人们对另一次冬季袭击的担忧。

俄罗斯对仓库的袭击就是其中之一。乌克兰迄今为止最致命的袭击，造成 38 人死亡。根据官员和国家安全专家的说法，俄罗斯在冬季对乌克兰能源基础设施的袭击构成了基辅迄今为止在战争中最严峻的挑战。

同时，本月晚些时候，美国众议院预计将通过一项纪念林赛·格雷厄姆的法案，该法案将对俄罗斯原油或天然气的前五个购买国（包括中国和俄罗斯）征收高达 100% 的关税。印度。

俄罗斯是印度最大的原油供应国，占印度6月和7月石油进口的50%以上，截至8月24日则接近43%。根据印度最新的贸易数据，4月至7月，俄罗斯对印度的出口额超过340亿美元，比去年增长近60%。

在与莫迪会晤期间，普京赞扬了两国双边贸易的增长，但补充道“去年略有下降。”

美国唐纳德·特朗普总统于 2025 年 8 月对印度与俄罗斯的能源贸易征收 25% 的惩罚性关税，使印度对美国的出口关税总额达到 50%。

虽然今年早些时候对印度的关税已降至 18%，但美国一直热衷于增加对印度的委内瑞拉原油供应，以取代俄罗斯的石油桶。

title: 安东尼·斯卡拉穆奇谈白宫解雇事件迫使他重新思考失败、自我和职业生涯
content:
安东尼·斯卡拉穆奇 (Anthony Scaramucci) 的职业生涯充满了引人注目的成功和挫折。

在这一集中的“高管决策”中，这位 SkyBridge Capital 创始人反思了离开高盛创办自己的企业的经历、为什么不安全感导致他在职业生涯早期走错了工作，以及影响他决定加入特朗普政府的骄傲和自负。

仅仅 11 天后就被白宫解雇，斯卡拉穆奇被建议从公共生活中消失。相反，他选择面对批评者 - 他说这一决定成为对他的错误、他的人际关系和他自己进行更广泛反思的一部分。

他还讨论了被高盛解雇和重新雇用、他从市场低迷中吸取的教训、重建 SkyBridge 以及它与 Sam Bankman-Fried 和 FTX 关系的后果。

通过这一切，斯卡拉穆奇表示，教训是一样的：承认自己的错误，面对错误音乐并继续前进。

无论您在何处获得播客，都可以订阅“史蒂夫·塞奇威克的执行决策”，或单击此处。

title: 据报道，欧洲在 G20 峰会上冷落莫斯科，贝森特告诉俄罗斯，在乌克兰战争结束之前不会有经济救济
content:
美国据报道，财政部长斯科特·贝森特 (Scott Bessent) 告诉俄罗斯财政部长安东·西卢阿诺夫 (Anton Siluanov)，只要乌克兰战争继续下去，就不可能解除制裁或与莫斯科达成新协议。

两位官员在北卡罗来纳州阿什维尔举行的 20 国集团财长会议期间会面。

贝森特的讲话是西卢阿诺夫自俄罗斯入侵乌克兰以来首次亲自出席峰会。 2022引起了其他欧洲领导人的反对。欧洲各国政府计划扩大制裁，以进一步挤压莫斯科的经济和财政。

这次罕见的会议凸显了华盛顿愿意与莫斯科重新开放高层外交渠道，尽管欧洲盟友打算在战争继续期间保持该国的孤立。

据路透社报道，贝森特向西卢阿诺夫明确表示，“在战争结束之前一切都是不可能的”，据路透社报道，当时俄罗斯部长提出了其他共同感兴趣的领域。

这次会议的重点是。据 Axios 报道，关于唐纳德·特朗普总统针对乌克兰和经济增长的和平计划，而俄罗斯财政部则将讨论内容描述为两国在 G20 框架内的金融合作。

俄罗斯的意外重返谈判桌引发了欧洲官员的沮丧，他们反对与西卢阿诺一起出现在传统的 G20 照片中，该照片最终是在没有俄罗斯部长的情况下拍摄的。

title: 八月是孩子们回归的月份。克莱默回顾了最大赢家的推动因素
content:
CNBC 的吉姆·克莱默 (Jim Cramers) 周一表示，对于那些遭受华尔街一些最有力的看跌言论打击的股票来说，8 月是一个卷土重来的月份。

他的评论是在 8 月的最后一个交易日发表的。 8 月份标准普尔 500 指数的几家最大赢家连续几个月承受着人工智能颠覆和经济增长放缓等担忧的压力。 Cramer 表示，基本面的改善有助于挑战这些担忧并推动大幅反弹。

在宣布与默克 (Merck) 合作开发的实验性黑色素瘤疫苗取得可喜成果后，该指数于 8 月进行了现代化调整，挑战了对其 mRNA 技术能否产生另一项重大突破的怀疑。 “这真是奇迹，所以它受到了奇迹般的欢迎，”克莱默说。 2026 年之前，由于对其 Covid-19 疫苗的需求减弱，Moderna 的股价多年来一直承受压力。

企业软件是 8 月份其他许多大幅反弹的原因。由于投资者质疑人工智能时代软件的耐用性，Palantir、Veeva Systems、Salesforce 和 ServiceNow 都面临不同程度的抛售。克莱默表示，态势感知基金的存在加剧了这些跌势，该基金是一家高杠杆基金，基于该论点对软件股进行了大量押注。 Situational Awareness 被迫在 7 月下旬平仓。

“随着 8 月即将结束，很难相信对冲基金内爆的影响会对本月的走势产生如此大的影响，”他表示。

Cramer 表示，考虑到 Palantir 收入增长和盈利能力的出色结合，其早期的下跌毫无意义。 Salesforce 在一个强劲的季度削弱了人们对“SaaS 末日”的担忧后出现反弹，而 ServiceNow 在表明它可以成功地将人工智能整合到其现有业务中后出现反弹。专注于生命科学行业的 Veeva 也与更广泛的软件集团一起反弹，因为人们担心人工智能会扰乱其业务，这一担忧被证明是过分的。

克莱默表示：“软件行业从极其低迷的水平中复苏是令人惊叹的。”

Gartner 早些时候因担心 Anthropic 的 Claude 等人工智能模型可能会减少其技术研究的需求而受到打击，随后也加入了反弹行列。 Cramer 表示，这些担忧最终并未反映在公司业务中。

在软件之外，矿商 Newmont 受益于金价的复苏，金价去年曾飙升，一直持续到 2026 年初，然后才触顶。可以肯定的是，克莱默表示，他更喜欢矿业公司 Agnico Eagle Mines 的股票，而不是纽蒙特公司的股票。

派拉蒙 Skydance 的股价也出现反弹，因为其拟议的华纳兄弟探索收购计划仍被推迟。上周，加州总检察长罗布·邦塔 (Rob Bonta) 取消了与派拉蒙 Skydance 的会面，因为该公司在早期和解谈判中表现出“缺乏诚意”。克莱默表示，投资者认为派拉蒙出价过高，这意味着完成交易的障碍实际上帮助了该股。

随着人工智能数据中心使用的内存需求旺盛，超微电脑和Sandisk股价也飙升。尽管超微在中国的业务受到持续审查，但其股价还是出现了上涨。就Sandisk而言，在经历了残酷的7月份股价下跌超过46%之后，Sandisk在8月份表现强劲。该股仍比 6 月底收盘高点低约 33%。

随着加密货币反弹，Coinbase 也跻身本月表现最佳股票之列。此次上涨之际，对政府支出膨胀和美国债务成本上升的担忧促使投资者将硬资产视为对冲美元疲软的手段。 Cramer 指出，该股票已成为寻求进入更广泛的加密货币市场的投资者的热门代表。

title: 华尔街收盘获胜后，股票期货几乎没有变化：实时更新
content:
周一晚间，股市期货在下跌后接近持平，但美国主要基准指数仍设法实现月度上涨。

道琼斯工业平均指数期货上涨 25 点。标准普尔 500 指数期货上涨不到 0.1%。纳斯达克 100 指数期货小幅走低。

标准普尔 500 指数上涨8 月份上涨 2.6%，而纳斯达克综合指数同期上涨 3.9%。道琼斯指数本月上涨 1.3%，连续第五个月上涨。

然而，华尔街本月收盘不佳。在美国袭击伊朗拉拉克岛的两座火箭发射器后，油价攀升，推高了利率，道指在常规交易中下跌了 370 多点。标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克综合指数当天也下跌。

“尽管进入今天交易的交易距离 ATH 不到 115 个基点，但市场在众多指标上都表现出紧张的迹象，”高盛交易员写道，并指出了新的美国个人投资者协会情绪调查数据。 “这种对风险的态度不仅仅是理论上的，投资者在投资组合风险分配方面确实是在把钱放在嘴上。”

最重要的是，9月份对股市来说是历史上最糟糕的一个月。

这些季节性因素加上拥挤的经济日历可能会让投资者在本周剩下的时间里保持警惕。制造业和服务业数据将于周二和周三公布。

周五，投资者将收到 8 月份就业报告。道琼斯调查的经济学家预计本月将增加 53,000 个就业岗位。

“华尔街需要疲软的统计数据来释放利率减免，这是过去几周的最大风险。疲软的劳动力数据将证明沃什联储采取平衡做法的合理性，导致委员会考虑该机构双重使命的就业方面，从而有效地放松金融状况。此外，连续第二个月的就业人数下降将刺激大量债券购买，因为盈透证券高级经济学家 Jose Torres 表示：“经济放缓的焦虑情绪在曲线上的定价更加严重。”

当期货市场下午 6 点开盘时，道琼斯工业平均指数期货上涨 25 点。周一美东时间。标准普尔 500 指数期货小幅走高，而纳斯达克 100 指数期货下跌不到 0.1%。

title: 降价后的 Shein 能否在期待已久的股市首秀中大放异彩？
content: Image source,Getty Images for SHEINByOsmond ChiaBusiness reporterPublished1 hour agoFast-fashion giant Shein is set to make its highly anticipated stock market debut on Tuesday as it lists in Hong Kong after a years-long quest to go public.It comes after failed attempts to list in the US and UK, as concerns were raised over issues including the firm's labour practices and its environmental impact.Once estimated to be worth nearly $100bn (Â£74bn), Shein is now valued at around a quarter of that figure, as the firm faces other issues like increased competition and global trade tensions.Shein has grown hugely popular, especially with younger customers, due to its ability to source the very latest fashions at ultra-low prices through avast network of factories in China.On Monday, Shein priced its shares below the top end of their marketed range, raising â13.6 billion Hong Kong dollars ($1.7bn; Â£1.3bn) from the listing.That gave the company a stock market valuation of $26.3bn.Founded in China and now headquartered in Singapore, Shein operates a global e-commerce network, with sales in more than 150 countries.Shein has 281 million active customers who placed a total of more than a billion orders in the year to the end of March 2026, the company said ina filing ahead of the listing.But its business model has come under intense scrutiny over environmental and human rights concerns, while US and European Union crackdowns on cheap imports are squeezing its finances.The stock market debut comes at a "complex moment" as investors grow sceptical over the performance of fast-fashion companies, said Louise Deglise-Favre from research firm GlobalData.A benchmark for fast fashionThe listing marks the largest new share sale in Hong Kong so far this year, which is being seen as a test of investor appetite for the fast fashion industry.It is a rare "standalone" e-commerce firm that can be assessed on its own merits, fashion industry analyst Deglise-Favre said.Shares in rivals Asos and Boohoo have been battered in recent years as they face regulatory scrutiny and fierce competition."Investors have learned to be sceptical," while concerns over sustainability and ethical issues add to the complexity of Shein's share sale, Deglise-Favre said.The rise and rise of fashion giant SheinPublished7 June 2024The truth behind your $12 dress: Inside the Chinese factories fuelling Shein's successPublished12 January 2025Shein's long road to the stock market highlights the geopolitical pressures and regulatory scrutiny faced by Chinese companies with global ambitions.The company once looked set for one of the largest stock market debuts ever by a Chinese firm, with Wall Street in its sights.Its business had surged during the Covid-19 pandemic as people, stuck at home, turned to online retailers.Shoppers shared clips of themselves trying on large numbers of its garments, a trend called Shein Hauls, boosting the company's online presence.An initial public offering (IPO) in the US - by far Shein's largest market - would have offered it a chance to further increase its global profile and tap into Western financing.But the firm faced resistance from US lawmakers, who objected to the planned listing over concerns of forced labour in Shein's factories. In response to such allegations, the company has said it takes a "zero-tolerance policy for forced labour".It has also been accused of copying other designers' ideas. Shein has said "it takes all claims of infringement seriously" and that it respects the rights of all designers.Shein also explored the possibility of making itsstock market debut in Londonbut faced similar opposition.The BBC has contacted Shein for further comment.'Only realistic path'In 2025, Shein shifted its attention to Hong Kong, with Chinese authorities approving the move in July this year."Shein ran out of venues that could take it," said Ashley Dudarenok, founder of Chinese market research firm ChoZan.The company attempted to "look less Chinese" by shifting its headquarters to Singapore ahead of its IPO bid, but it never won political backing abroad nor assurances from Beijing, she added.Image source,AFP via Getty ImagesImage caption,Shein is backed by a vast network of factories in China"For Chinese companies increasingly shut out of Western exchanges, Hong Kong is fast becoming the only realistic path to market," Deglise-Favre said.The move also coincided with Shein's publicity-shy founder Xu Yangtian making arare public appearanceduring a major business conference in February.Xu took to a stage in Guangdong, home to many of China's garment factories, to re-affirm his company's ties to Beijing.He pledged investments in China's clothing industry, adding that the "nourishment" from the country has been "inseparable" from Shein's success.Headwinds aheadTrade tensions and regulatory concerns mean Shein is navigating a very different landscape to when it first started exploring a potential IPO.In July,it reported a $99m quarterly lossas its sales slowed after the US struck down an import duty exemption on small packages.The exemption,known as the de minimis rule, had helped Shein and rival Temu grow rapidly as it allowed packages worth less than $800 to enter the US without incurring import duties.Similarly, the European Union has imposed a â¬3 (Â£2.57; $3.50) tax on low-value imports.The Iran war has also hit demand, raised costs and caused delays to deliveries in some markets, Shein has said.Image source,AFP via Getty ImagesImage caption,Shein's fast-fashion model has come under scrutiny over its environmental impactIts rivals are feeling the pressure too. In August, Temu-owner PDD reported lower-than-expected quarterly revenue.Shein is also being investigated by US and European regulators over its business practices.Despite these challenges some analysts still see strong potential for Shein.Investors will be scrutinising whether the company can navigate theses issues, such as shifting logistics out of China to avoid the US and EU's import fees, Deglise-Favre said.The slump in the firm's valuation shows "genuine deterioration", but it is still backed by a "formidable supply chain" and a global reach, she added.People are still buying the company's goods, but costs have weighed on its business and have shown that its business model does not generate profits in the way it once did, said Dudarenok.As a publically-listed company, Shein will need to "prove its margins still work in a world of tighter regulation, tariffs and more expensive customer acquisition," she added.Related topicsInternational BusinessStock marketsChinaHong KongMore on this storyHow US shoppers will be hit as 'de minimis' tariff exemption endsPublished29 August 2025Tech manufacturing has powered Asia - now it's a casualty of Trump's tariffsPublished1 August 2025

title: 众议院情报委员会警告“黑天鹅”人工智能风险
content:
众议院情报常设特别委员会敦促美国间谍机构更好地应对“黑天鹅”人工智能风险，并在一份新报告中警告称，恐怖分子或对手可能会利用该技术开发更危险的武器并策划更致命的袭击。

“该委员会认为，[情报界]和更广泛的政策制定者必须仔细考虑如何防止人工智能工具被流氓行为者利用，包括恐怖分子，”报告说。该报告旨在评估美国在过去四分之一个世纪中为解决导致 2001 年 9 月 11 日恐怖袭击的情报失误所做的努力。

“自 9/11 以来，防止恐怖组织获得制造和使用大规模杀伤性武器所需的设备和专业知识一直是情报委员会和国家安全机构的一个重要重点，”报告称。 “前沿大型语言模型有可能使包括恐怖分子在内的任何流氓行为者更容易开发和实施更具破坏性的攻击。”

这份报告对人工智能的破坏潜力发出了警告，距离 9/11 恐怖袭击 25 周年还有不到两周的时间，这场恐怖袭击造成数千人死亡，并重塑了美国的安全工作。与此同时，人工智能正在迅速发展并推动巨大的经济活动，导致立法者和官员们努力解决有关技术监管的难题。

该报告由众议院情报委员会主席、阿肯色州共和党人 Rick Crawford 和高级议员、康涅狄格州民主党人 Jim Himes、以及纽约州共和党众议员 Elise Stefanik 和新泽西州民主党众议员 Josh Gottheimer 撰写。他们警告说，现有的保障措施可能不足以跟上人工智能的进步。

立法者写道：“虽然人工智能实验室试图阻止模型返回可能协助不良行为者的信息，例如，制造生物武器，但模型的潜在能力正在迅速发展，模型的这种使用很难完全控制。”立法者写道。

立法者敦促情报界“加速其负责任地采用先进的人工智能能力，以便美国保持领先地位”。领先于对手。”它还表示，投资“用于收集、分析和警告的安全人工智能工具，加上严格的测试、人工监督以及强有力的隐私和公民自由保护”对于解决下一代威胁至关重要。

委员会普遍认为，美国“面临着自 2001 年 9 月 11 日以来最复杂和危险的威胁环境。”

“我们面对和解决这些漏洞的能力仍然存在严重差距。我们没有做好充分准备面对并解决我们的弱点，”报告写道。

title: KKR 支持的 OPI 指甲油母公司 Wella Co. 申请美国 IPO
content:
KKR 支持的 OPI 指甲油母公司 Wella Company 周一申请在美国首次公开募股 (IPO)，加入了越来越多希望吸引投资者对公开市场兴趣的消费品公司名单。

这家头发和指甲护理公司在 100 多个国家/地区开展业务，拥有员工 6,000 多名，主要办事处位于日内瓦、瑞士、纽约市、伦敦和加利福尼亚州卡拉巴萨斯，以及德国达姆施塔特的大型研发机构。

路透社今年早些时候报道称，该公司还拥有 Wella 护发产品，一直在与投资银行合作，为 IPO 做准备。

全球投资公司 KKR 最初于 2020 年从美容集团 Coty 手中收购了 Wella 60% 的股份，当时 Wella被拆分为一家独立公司，业务估值为 43 亿美元，包括债务。

Wella 打算在纽约证券交易所上市，代码为“WELA”。高盛、美国银行证券、KKR 和摩根大通是此次发行的承销商之一。

title: 特朗普称美国经济增速可能达到 20%。二战以来只发生过一次
content:
唐纳德·特朗普总统周一表示，美国经济可能以高达 20% 的速度增长，同时认为即使如此快速的增长也不应促使美联储加息。

“我们的 GDP 可以达到 14、15、16 和 20，”特朗普在椭圆形办公室宣布旨在降低处方药价格协议的活动中表示。 “增长的成功不会导致通货膨胀。”

特朗普发表此番言论之际，他仍在继续推动降低借贷成本，尽管美联储官员仍在应对仍高于 2% 目标的通胀问题。

美联储 7 月份将基准利率稳定在 3.5% 至 3.75%，三位政策制定者反对加息 25 个基点。许多美联储观察人士预计联邦公开市场委员会将在 9 月份的下一次会议上加息。

但在现代美国经济中，任何接近特朗普提出的水平的增长几乎都是史无前例的。

根据经济分析局 1947 年的数据，实际国内生产总值在短短一个季度内就实现了 20% 或更高的年化增长率。那是 2020 年第三季度，当时经济以根据 BEA 数据，随着新冠肺炎 (Covid-19) 大范围停工后企业重新开业，年化增长率为 34.9%。上一季度年化收缩 28% 后出现反弹。

下一个最高季度是 1950 年第一季度，随着美国和世界摆脱第二次世界大战以及婴儿潮一代的诞生，实际 GDP 年化增长率为 16.7%。在近八个十年的系列中，没有其他季度达到 20%。

今天的经济增长速度只是这些速度的一小部分。根据 BEA 的最新估计，2026 年第二季度实际 GDP 年化增长率为 1.5%，低于第一季度的 2.1%。

季度 GDP 增长率按年化增长率报告，这意味着 20% 的读数并不代表单个季度增长 20%。

特朗普将更快增长的潜力视为美联储应该降低而不是提高利率的另一个原因

“我们应该拥有世界上最低的利率，”特朗普在回答记者有关美联储可能加息的问题时表示。 “过去……如果我们宣布良好的数据，利率就会下降。现在，如果你宣布良好的数据，利率就会上升，因为他们非常害怕通货膨胀。”

强劲的经济增长并不一定会导致通货膨胀。如果生产力和生产能力随着需求的增长而增长，经济就可以在没有重大价格压力的情况下快速扩张。但当需求增长速度快于经济生产商品和服务的能力时，就会推高价格。

title: Microsoft Outlook 和 OpenAI 的 ChatGPT Work 遇到用户中断
content:
长期合作伙伴 OpenAI 和微软均表示，周一他们的关键产品出现了中断，但没有相关报告。

OpenAI 表示，其企业人工智能代理 ChatGPT Work 的错误率和延迟已持续约三个小时。微软表示，Exchange Online 存在问题。“多个订阅计划的用户可能无法在 ChatGPT Work 中启动或继续任务，”OpenAI 在其状态页面上表示。 “我们正在继续努力实施缓解措施。” 截至下午 2:24美国东部时间周一，超过 1,100 名用户在 DownDetector（一个跟踪中断的网站）上报告了 OpenAI 产品的问题。对于 Microsoft Outlook，此后不久该数字接近 4,600。两者在当天早些时候都达到了峰值。“ChatGPT Work 现在无法工作，”OpenAI 的 ChatGPT 帐户在 aposton X 中写道。“对此感到抱歉，我们正在努力修复！”

7 月，OpenAI 推出了 ChatGPT Work，这是一款与 Anthropic 的 Claude Cowork 直接竞争的企业代理。该代理旨在帮助员工承担更多“雄心勃勃的任务”，例如创建精美的幻灯片、网络应用程序、表格、文档以及执行其他复杂项目。

微软于 2019 年向 OpenAI 投资了第一笔 10 亿美元，为这家软件巨头在人工智能领域提供了早期立足点，比 ChatGPT 推出早了三年。随着战略关系的加强，这项投资后来增加到 130 亿美元，但最近两家公司一直在多个战线展开竞争。

“我们已经确认，用户可能会遇到各种 Exchange Online 功能降级的情况，”微软通过其 365 状态帐户向 X 表示。 “我们正在审查服务遥测和诊断数据，以找出问题的根源。”

title: Citadel 证券表示，随着历史上艰难的月份开始，股票的风险回报前景变得越来越糟
content:
众所周知，9 月份是股市最糟糕的月份，标准普尔 500 指数的平均月回报率最低。再加上目前全年最便宜的期权价格，在股市购买保护的风险回报看起来很有吸引力。

这是 Citadel 证券股票和股票衍生品策略主管 Scott Rubner 的观点，他周一写信给客户，表示标准普尔 8 月份创下历史新高的看涨格局正在发生变化。

“这不是我们长期建设性股票观点的变化。这是近期风险/回报的变化，”Rubner在一份策略报告中写道，指出收益日历、回购前景、季节性和零售交易模式是谨慎的原因。

“总的来说，它们改变了近期的不对称性，”鲁布纳说。 “随着下行催化剂变得越来越多，上行催化剂变得越来越不明显。”

标准普尔 500 指数本月盘中创下 7,816.70 点的历史新高，自 7 月底到 8 月第一周上涨近 7%。此后，随着芝加哥期权交易所波动率指数 (VIX) 衡量的波动率上周跌至 14.1——全年最低水平，该基准指标横向走低。

根据芝加哥期权交易所的数据，与指数波动率相比处于历史高位的单只股票波动率也有所下降，并援引了该交易所 VIXEQ 指数的利差——该指数衡量标准普尔 500 强 50 强的隐含波动率。同样，根据芝加哥期权交易所 (Cboe) 的数据，景顺信托 QQQ 衡量的纳斯达克 100 指数与 SPY 之间的价差从 6 月份的历史最高点降至一年来最低的 20%。

“随着对人工智能交易的担忧消退，强于预期的科技股盈利（正如上周 NVDA 所见）帮助压缩了科技股的波动性风险溢价，”芝加哥期权交易所衍生品市场情报主管 Mandy Xu 写道。周一早上的说明。

因此，根据 Citadel 的鲁布纳的说法，下行保护的成本并不高。

根据鲁布纳的说法，从历史角度来看，9 月不仅仅是艰难的时期。这也是 Citadel 追踪的零售交易商一年中购买活动最疲软的月份。自 2019 年以来，标准普尔指数下跌期间的平均零售净买入量约为平均水平的一半。

鲁布纳还写道，随着企业回购股票的禁售期在 9 月 12 日左右加速，企业回购将会放缓。

“投资者正在进入一个宏观事件更加频繁的时期，同时支付的保护溢价相对较少，”鲁布纳表示。

title: 美国袭击伊朗后股市下跌，但华尔街即将迎来胜利之月：实时更新
content:
Stocks fell on Monday after the U.S. and Irantraded firefor the first time in a month, though the major averages were still pacing to close out August with gains.

TheS&P 500slipped 0.5%, as did theNasdaq Composite. TheDow Jones Industrial Averagetraded 361 points, or 0.7%, lower, dragged down by losses inGoldman SachsandAlphabet.

On Sunday, U.S. Central Command confirmed to MS NOW that the U.S. struck two rocket launchers on Iran's Larak Island.

Sunday's attack was the first publicly acknowledged U.S. strike on Iranian positions since late July, with Iranian state media reporting that Tehran had attacked U.S. bases in Jordan in retaliation.

Oil prices jumpedafter the hostilities resumed.U.S. West Texas Intermediate oiltraded more than 2% higher at above $85 per barrel, while global benchmarkBrent crude oil futureswere up more than 2% at above $90 a barrel.

Longer-dated Treasury yields rosealongside oil prices Monday, adding to the downbeat sentiment in equities.

While Tom Hainlin of U.S. Bank Asset Management noted that oil's current levels are "a little high," the latest advance shouldn't be significantly damaging.

"The world's got enough oil for what it needs, and $80 to $90 is not so restrictive that it collapses the economy," the firm's national investment strategist said. "Today's indication just puts us at the high end of that range, but it doesn't change our outlook for the consumer, for business, for AI, manufacturing reshoring or continued electrification of the economy."

If oil climbs above $100 a barrel, then that may start to get "pretty prohibitive," he added.

Heightened tensions in the Middle East have contributed to choppy trading in August, but Wall Street is currently on track for a month of broad gains, led by the tech sector.

The Dow is up more than 1% month to date, putting the index on track for its fifth consecutive monthly advance. The S&P 500 and Nasdaq were headed for their first one-month increases since May, up about 2% and 3%, respectively. Both the S&P 500 and Dow also reached all-time highs earlier in August.

Tech led the charge this month, with artificial intelligence-linked stocks outperforming. The S&P 500 tech sector is up nearly 6% for the month.Nvidiahas climbed more than 9%, whileMicrosoftandMicron Technologyadvanced 10% and 15%, respectively.

To be sure, August has still been a turbulent month, as inflation fears sent Treasury yields to multi-year highs. The Treasury Department tried to stem the rout by saying itwould increase debt repurchases, but yields along the long end of the curve remain elevated. Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warshalso said Fridayhe's worried about inflation, noting that, "while this summer's [inflation] readings were better than expected, they do not tell me that underlying trends have meaningfully improved."

Investors will get more insight into the state of the economy this week, with the August jobs report due Friday morning. Monthly manufacturing and services sector data is also on deck.

Traders will also be watching for developments out of Asheville, North Carolina, where ameeting of the Group of 20 finance ministersis taking place.

The stock market still has room to broaden beyond AI-related names into more cyclical areas, but warned that the outlook depended heavily on a continued soft landing, according to Scott Chronert, head of U.S. equity strategy at Citi Research.

"All in all, the balance which Mr. Warsh seems to be bringing to the Fed process appears reasonable, and we look forward to more from the Fed's task forces," Chronert wrote in his Friday note.

However, he said Citi's broadening call remains dependent on "some combination of lower oil prices, resultant lesser inflation pressure, and, ultimately, room for the Fed to react more dovishly to mixed labor trends."

Chronert said Citi would like to seeWTI crudefall back below $80 a barrel along with the10-year Treasuryyield move lower as the Fed provides some relief on rates.

"Confidence in soft-landing economic conditions remains critical to the broadening playbook, in our view, and this still appears to be the appropriate backdrop," he said.

A 6% annual appreciation in the Chinese yuan relative to the dollar is pulling down estimates for iPhone price hikes and their effect on the company's gross margins, according to investment bank Jefferies.

The potential hikes on the higher storage units of the Apple mobile phone could be 5 to 8 percentage points lower than previous estimates, analysts said in a Monday note to clients.

Those units account for "only 2% - 3% of the vol but the original prices likely yield higher [gross margins]," Edison Lee at Jefferies wrote to clients.

Check out some of the companies making the biggest moves midday:

Apple'slead for its App Store and events has stepped down from his role, Bloomberg reported on Monday.

Citing people familiar with the matter, Bloomberg added that Schiller will remain at the company and will work on unnamed initiatives.

Schiller's role change comes just before John Ternus is set to take over from Tim Cook as CEO of the consumer technology giant on Tuesday. Shares hit their lows of the session and were off about 2% after the report.

While theS&P 500was under pressure on Monday, falling 0.5% in midday trading thanks in part to a decline in utility stocks likeEdison International,Teslashares stood out with a gain of around 5%.

Ulta Beautywas another winner on Monday, with shares rising roughly 4%.

California-based utility providers headed for their worst day in several years on Monday.

Edison Internationalcratered more than 22%, which would mark its largest one-day decline since 2001.PG&Eshares plunged around 19% in midday trading, on track for their worst day since 2020.

Monday's decline came after California lawmakers reportedly stopped Gov. Gavin Newsom's plan to insulate utility providers from lawsuits by insurers over wildfires.

Energy is the only S&P 500 sector in positive territory on Monday morning.

The group was up about 2%, putting its gain this month at more than 6%.

Among the remaining 10 sectors, communication services and utilities were the two biggest laggards, falling 1.9% and 1.6%, respectively. The two are pacing for a monthly loss of 1.5% and 5.6%.

Federal Reserve ChairKevin Warshexpressed confidence in the U.S. economy during brief remarks Monday morning at the G20 conference.

"As I show up today, 100 days into my tenure, a comment that I made in Jackson Hole a day or two ago is that secular stagnation seems like a description of a past long ago. The new period is one of secular growth," Warsh said, referring to his Friday presentation at the Fed's annual symposium in Wyoming.

The central bank leader added that the current climate is "one of a global investment surge," echoing a theme he has sounded repeatedly over the past several months of artificial intelligence spurring cash flows towards business growth.

The three major averages began Monday's session in the red.

The S&P 500 fell 0.2% just after the opening bell, along with the Nasdaq Composite. The Dow Jones Industrial Average shed 207 points, or 0.4%.

With the last regular session of August about to kick off, here's how the three leading U.S. indexes have fared month to date:

TheRussell 2000 indexis also pacing to finish the month higher, having climbed 1.4% so far.

In markets as in movies, suspense builds through the slow, quiet scenes of the second act.

The stock market is doing just enough, through slim trading volumes and narrow index trading ranges, to escape August with its uptrend intact.

The S&P 500 is within half a percent of where it closed three weeks ago. It has slouched and equivocated in the two weeks since it hit the last record high just above 7800.

But the index has stayed within 2% of the peak, the pullbacks so far halting a handful of points above what had been the top of the former multi-month range.Read more.

Check out the companies making the biggest moves premarket:

Aonagreed to pay private equity giant KKR $17 billion for USI Insurance Service, the companies confirmed Monday.

The deal is "expected to deliver $395 million in annual run-rate net adjusted EBITDA impact from revenue and cost synergies," they said in a release.

"Combining with USI will establish the premier U.S. middle-market platform, deepen our context advantage and position Aon to accelerate organic growth. Building on the success of our acquisition of NFP, USI will substantially enhance our middle-market footprint," Aon CEO Greg Case said in a statement.

Aon and KKR shares were flat in the premarket.

Short-term government borrowing costs in various markets reached multi-year highs on Monday, as fresh U.S.-Iran combat fueled inflation fears.

The resumption of hostilities added to fears around inflation and interest rate hikes that were stoked by an unexpectedly hawkish speech from Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh at the Jackson Hole symposium on Friday.

The yield onJapan's 2-year government bondtouched a 31-year high on Monday, whileGermany's 2-year bundyield was trading at its highest level since July 2024. France's2-year government bondyield rose to its highest since April 2024.

Bond prices move inversely to yields.

Bonds at the short end of the curve saw a broad sell-off across Europe, with short-term government borrowing costs also rising in theU.K., Spain, Portugal, Poland and Switzerland.

title: 由于新的中东袭击推高油价，抵押贷款利率飙升至 2025 年 6 月以来的最高水平
content:
伊朗战争重新爆发敌对行动后，油价上涨推高了债券收益率，抵押贷款利率也随之走高。

据《抵押新闻日报》报道，30年期固定贷款平均利率周一上涨6个基点至6.87%。这是自 2025 年 6 月以来的最高水平。自周四以来已上涨 12 个基点，并且在过去两个月中已上涨超过 30 个基点。

“虽然从技术上讲，利率处于一年多以来的最高水平，但它们并没有出现令人惊讶的新势头，”《抵押新闻日报》首席运营官马修·格雷厄姆 (Matthew Graham) 表示。 “相反，这更多的是由通常的嫌疑人推动的缓慢磨难：通胀预期、债券发行增加和经济弹性。所有这三个因素在未来至少都会受到一些变化的影响。”

人们原本预计今年利率会下降，但与伊朗的战争及其导致的油价上涨颠覆了这一预期。战争爆发前一天，即 2 月底，30 年期固定利率为 5.99%。

从这个角度来看，对于购买价值 45 万美元（约为全国中位数）的房屋的人来说，如果支付 30 年期固定抵押贷款 20% 的首付，那么今天每月还本金和利息将为 2,363 美元。这比 2 月底时每月多出 207 美元。

CNBC 与戴安娜·奥利克 (Diana Olick) 进行的房地产游戏为房地产投资者提供了新的和不断变化的机会，每周发送到您的收件箱。

立即订阅此处即可访问。

这只是付款。当利率上升时，有资格获得抵押贷款的借款人就会减少，因为这会改变贷方安全借贷所依赖的债务与收入比率。

这是在房价上涨的基础上出现的，由于供应不足，目前该国某些地区的房价似乎再次加速上涨。

根据最新的 S&P Cotality 数据，在全国范围内，6 月份的房价同比上涨 1.5%，而 5 月份的涨幅为 1.2%。凯斯-席勒房价指数。

“由于潜在买家的融资成本居高不下，当前的房主仍然不愿意放弃前几年获得的低抵押贷款利率，”标普道琼斯指数大宗商品副总监丽贝卡·考夫曼 (Rebecca Kaufman) 在新闻稿中表示。

title: 特朗普表示，反对人工智能数据中心的美国社区最终可能会“落后和贫穷”
content:
总统唐纳德·特朗普周一抨击了反对新数据中心的社区，共和党人在 11 月中期选举前面临选民对这些项目的强烈反对。

特朗普在《真相社会》帖子中写道，“美国各地的社区不想要数据中心的唯一原因是他们希望最终变得落后和贫穷。”

“如果他们想要成功和富有，那么各地的税收和就业机会都要低得多总统说。

“好消息是，还有很多其他地方想要它们。如果我们扼杀了金鹅，你们只能怪中国自己。事实上，他们不敢相信这一切正在发生！”

特朗普的帖子是在全国共和党参议院委员会发布备忘录警告“如果选民的看法”之后发布的。 NRSC 表示，该州的私人民意调查显示，在填补副总统 JD 万斯空出席位的剩余任期的特别选举中，共和党参议员乔恩·赫斯特德 (Jon Husted) 与民主党挑战者谢罗德·布朗 (Sherrod Brown) 处于“不相上下”状态。

5 月，盖洛普表示，3 月份进行的一项调查发现，“十分之七的美国人反对构建数据” 8月28日，Wolfe Research发布报告称，“在过去一个月左右的时间里，几乎每次与投资者会面时，我们都会被问到：选民对数据中心的强烈反对将如何发展？”

“反对的速度和规模确实令人惊叹——我们从未见过这样的情况，”报告称。 “过去 12 个月，跨党派对本地数据中心 (DC) 建设的净支持率下降了 60 个百分点。”

即将举行的中期选举将决定哪个政党控制国会两院。共和党在众议院以微弱优势占据多数，在参议院以 53 比 47 占据多数。

AI 数据中心拥有用于训练和运行 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 等公司开发的人工智能模型的计算设备。

急于建设数据中心的做法在美国各地社区引发了强烈反对，反对者对电力成本、电力需求、用水和其他当地影响表示担忧。

在 8 月 18 日的报告中在备忘录中，NRSC 警告说，美国人对数据中心的“当前看法是负面的”，因为它详细说明了这个问题如何影响俄亥俄州参议院的竞选。

“私下民意调查一直是一致的：当选民听到布朗的立场和他的记录时，赫斯特德退缩了。这仍然是这场竞选的路径，”备忘录说。 “新的成分（和新的问题）是数据中心。

NRSC 表示，“俄亥俄州是建设这些人工智能工厂的领导者之一。布朗已将其反对它们作为反对 Husted 的运动的核心。布朗正在使用它，因为它有效。”

“在这场竞赛中，数据中心比任何其他事情都更重要，是挂在 Husted 脖子上的锚。如果他输了并且数据中心受到指责，全国各地的政治家都会注意到 - 他们不会接近下一个。”

title: 等待购房变得更加实惠？这是 2027 年的预期
content:
如果您在买房之前一直在等待房地产市场变得更加实惠，那么 2027 年可能不会带来太大的缓解。

最新预测表明，明年 30 年期固定抵押贷款利率可能会保持在 7% 附近，从而使潜在买家的借贷成本保持在较高水平。据《抵押新闻日报》报道，目前 30 年期固定利率平均为 6.81%。

房利美目前预计 2027 年平均利率为 6.7%，较一个月前预测的 6.3% 显着上升。抵押贷款银行家协会 8 月份的预测还预计明年的平均利率为 6.7%，高于 6 月份预测的 6.5%。

换句话说，原本预计抵押贷款利率会放松的预测者现在预计抵押贷款利率将大致保持在目前的水平。

“最近的负担能力挑战大多来自抵押贷款利率的上升。实际上，2026 年全国房价一直在同比下降。 Realtor.com 的高级经济学家乔尔·伯纳 (Joel Berner) 表示。 “但在幕后，通货膨胀才是真正的罪魁祸首。”

当通货膨胀居高不下时，投资者通常会要求更高的国债收益率，这也会导致抵押贷款利率走高。高通胀还会导致买家的消费能力下降，并使房屋建造成本更高。

Realtor.com 自己的预测是，2026 年剩余时间抵押贷款利率约为 6.3%，该公司此后表示，由于通胀和伊朗战争给利率带来新的上行压力，这一前景“可能过于乐观”。

对于潜在买家来说，这意味着等到 2027 年买房可能不会有太大帮助更便宜。

抵押贷款利率往往跟踪 10 年期国债的收益率，而该收益率受到通胀和经济增长预期的影响。当通货膨胀预计将保持在高位时，国债收益率和抵押贷款利率可能会随之上升。

“经济现实迫使即使是最乐观的利率预测者也不得不预测比今年早些时候预期更高的利率环境，”Polunsky Beitel Green 的住宅抵押贷款律师马蒂·格林 (Marty Green) 表示。

根据经济分析局的数据，美联储首选的通胀指标 7 月份较上年同期上升了 3.7%，远高于央行的预期2%的年度目标。格林指出，新的关税和伊朗战争可能会导致通胀居高不下，并使抵押贷款利率下降更难以预测。

通胀也在侵蚀购房者的购买力。根据布鲁金斯学会汉密尔顿项目对联邦数据的分析，2026 年上半年，在对通货膨胀进行调整后，平均时薪年化下降了 1.66%。

与此同时，购房者仍面临着比 2020 年高出约 59% 的房价，并且预计房价将继续攀升。房利美 (Fannie Mae) 对 100 多名住房专家进行的最新调查预计，2027 年全国房价将上涨 2.2%。

在房价与抵押贷款利率一起上涨的市场中，伯纳称其为负担能力的“双重打击”。

建造更多房屋可能有助于缓解价格压力，但建造这些房屋的成本也变得更高。

关税正在提高整个过程中使用的材料的价格。根据全国住宅建筑商协会的数据，住宅包括木材、胶合板、钢、铝、铜和水泥。建筑商还面临技术工人持续短缺的问题。

伊朗战争也增加了开支。据 NAHB 称，油价上涨推高了天然气和柴油价格，使得建筑材料的生产和运输成本更高。

伯纳表示，“这会导致交付给房地产市场的库存（数量）减少且价格更便宜。”

title: 特朗普敦促苹果将地图上的“安大略湖”改为“美国湖”
content: 图片来源，盖蒂图片社图片说明，唐纳德·特朗普周四签署了一项行政命令，将五大湖之一的安大略湖更名为美国湖 作者：Nadine Yousif 加拿大资深记者 2026 年 8 月 31 日发布 内政部长道格·布尔古姆 (Doug Burgum) 表示，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普 (Donald Trump) 已要求科技公司苹果公司在其地图平台上将安大略湖更名为美国湖 (Lake America)，以遵守他更改五大湖名称的行政命令。布尔古姆告诉福克斯商业频道 (Fox Business)。周一的《Mornings with Maria》节目称，“总统已直接与苹果公司联系”，并补充道：“我相信我们可能很快就会看到这一变化。”谷歌在周末为美国用户做出了这一改变，尽管加拿大用户仍然将与安大略省和纽约州接壤的湖泊视为安大略湖。英国广播公司已联系苹果公司征求评论。加拿大在美国安装了大型安大略湖标志。1天前发布了美加贸易战5月1天前发布的重命名在加拿大面临阻力，周日，一家电力公用事业公司因其地图上显示了美洲湖的名字而道歉。总部位于多伦多的公用事业公司Hydro One在X上的一篇帖子中表示，该名称的出现是由于他们使用了第三方地图服务。“我们正在与我们的供应商合作，尽快纠正问题并恢复正确的地理参考，”该公司在声明中表示。 “我们对这个错误感到遗憾，并对由此造成的任何混乱表示歉意。”其他安大略省机构的地图似乎也短暂显示了“美洲湖”这个名字，包括渥太华水电局和安大略省酒类委员会。图标题，观看：“他失去了它”——美国人对安大略湖更名的反应在加拿大和美国之间的贸易谈判破裂后，特朗普于周四签署了行政命令，寻求将安大略湖更名为美洲湖。该命令指示布尔古姆“采取一切适当行动”重新命名包括更新美国政府官方地图数据库地名信息系统（GNIS）。谷歌在周六的一份声明中表示，其地图将向美国用户显示美洲湖名称，以遵守 GNIS。它补充说，加拿大用户将继续看到安大略湖的显示。在世界其他地方，用户将看到名称显示为：安大略湖（美洲湖）。并非所有地图提供商都在更改名称。 MapQuest 是 1996 年推出的美国免费网络地图服务，周五在 Facebook 的一篇简短帖子中表示“我们不会改变它”。该平台还推出了一个工具，允许用户将安大略湖更改为他们选择的任何名称并分享他们的创作。在宣布不会更改安大略湖的名称后，截至周一早上，MapQuest 跃居加拿大 Apple App Store 下载次数最多的免费应用程序的榜首。安大略省省长道格·福特 (Doug Ford) 于周六在湖边揭晓了一个巨大标志：用英语和法语（加拿大的官方语言）阅读《安大略湖现在和永远》。“没有人会称它为美国湖，”福特周日告诉美国电视主持人乔治·斯蒂芬诺普洛斯。 “数百年来一直是安大略湖。它将继续是安大略湖。”五大湖中的四个湖的名称 - 安大略湖、休伦湖、密歇根湖和伊利湖 - 源自土著语言。相关主题安大略省加拿大苹果唐纳德·特朗普

title: 专家说，当有人居高临下地对你说话时，使用多莉·帕顿的简单技巧来“维护你的尊严并解除他们的武装”
content:
当有人光顾你时，你很容易感到被轻视。也许他们认为你不知道自己在做什么，因为你是一个组织的新手，或者你很年轻。也许他们认为你无法使用新技术，因为你年纪大了。

在这种情况下知道该怎么做并不总是那么容易。他们对你能力的假设是不正确的，但你也不想否认一个明显的事实。也许您是某个组织的年长者、年轻者或新人。如何在保持自己身份的同时有效地维护自己的利益？

多莉·帕顿（Dolly Parton）知道答案。近半个世纪前，她对当时最著名的电视记者之一芭芭拉·沃尔特斯（Barbara Walters）进行了一次著名的采访。沃尔特斯当着帕顿的面问了人们在她背后窃窃私语的所有尖锐问题：关于她的衣服、她的身材，甚至她的胸部。她还强调了帕顿的下层阶级背景。

“多莉，”她开始说道。 “我来自哪里，我会称你为乡下人吗？......当我想到乡下人时，我想到的是你们这种人吗？”

我在哥伦比亚商学院和杜克大学福卡商学院教授传播学十多年，帕顿的回答给我们所有人都提供了一个强有力的教训。

“我想你可能是，”她回答道。 “但我们是非常自豪的人，有很多阶级的人。这是乡村阶级，但它是一个很大的阶级。我的大多数人没有受过多少教育，但他们非常非常聪明。良好的常识 - 我们称之为马意识。”我将帕顿的举动称为“标签升级”策略，这是一种既维护你的尊严又解除对你说话的人的武装的方法。

她也不否认她是一个乡巴佬，也不会因为容易被视为侮辱的事情而生气。相反，她声称拥有该标签并修改了其含义。对沃尔特斯来说，“乡巴佬”显然意味着“落后”或“不成熟”。但帕顿拥有它并改变了含义：作为一个乡巴佬现在意味着自豪、务实和明智。

下次有人试图居高临下地对你说话时，你不必争论。相反，你可以使用相同的策略，重新定义他们试图给你贴上的标签或框。如果他们说或暗示你“太缺乏经验”，你可以加倍强调你的新鲜观点。如果他们试图责备你“过分”，你可以强调你的智慧和判断力。

标签升级分为两部分。首先，你接受他们所说的内容是准确的（假设它是准确的——否则，你可以质疑他们的前提）。然后，您重新定义它的含义。听起来可能是这样的：

或者，如果你是多莉·帕顿 (Dolly Parton)，你可以对芭芭拉·沃尔特斯 (Barbara Walters) 说，她质疑她的“极端服装”和金发假发：“这当然是一个选择。我不喜欢和其他人一样。我经常说过，我永远不会为了时尚而卑躬屈膝。这是世界上最容易做的事情。”承认事实是一个强有力的举措，同时仍然可以定义事实为自己制定条件。您可能没有太多经验，但您的观点可能是一种资产。你可能没有 MBA 学位，但你的想法可能仍然是最好的。当您像多莉·帕顿（Dolly Parton）那样使用标签升级策略时，您不会接受任何人的定义，而是接受您自己的定义。

多里·克拉克（Dorie Clark）在哥伦比亚商学院和杜克大学福卡商学院教授高管教育十多年。她是一位主讲人、前总统竞选发言人以及畅销书《漫长的游戏》的作者。您可以在此处订阅她的电子通讯。

title: G20 金融会议实时更新：Bessent、Warsh 发表讲话
content:

国际金融领导人、央行行长和其他高级官员的会议召开之际，世界经济正处于一个不稳定的时刻，因为唐纳德·特朗普总统发动了伊朗战争，美国债务激增，通货膨胀问题持续存在。引发了全球不确定性。

为期两天的会议吸引了众多知名首席执行官，包括摩根大通的杰米·戴蒙和高盛的大卫·所罗门，他们都定于周一晚些时候发表讲话。

CNBC 正在华盛顿特区纽约市阿什维尔和新泽西州恩格尔伍德克利夫斯报道 G20 会议。

“我认为这可能会在几周或几个月内，”他说，但补充道，“经济不必崩溃……我们只需让这个政权清醒过来。”

“我认为他们正在猛烈抨击，因为他们

财政部阻止《纽约时报》、《华尔街日报》和彭博社的一些记者参加在阿什维尔举行的会议，并禁止美国最大、最有影响力的三个新闻编辑室进入。

title: OpenAI 广告业务增长强劲，年化收入达到 10 亿美元
content:
OpenAI 周一宣布，其广告业务年化收入已达到 10 亿美元，该公司将这一里程碑视为其“多元化商业模式”的证明。

这家人工智能公司正在为预计将进行的大规模 IPO 做准备，并面临着向投资者证明其 8520 亿美元估值合理性的压力。 OpenAI 周一表示，其广告业务已有大约 200 天的历史，建立在现有的收入引擎基础上，例如企业产品、消费者订阅和基于使用的应用程序编程接口。

OpenAI 于 2 月份开始在美国的 ChatGPT 聊天机器人中测试广告，这一决定既备受期待，又引起争议。数字广告长期以来一直是 Google 和 Meta 等其他大型科技公司的摇钱树，但 OpenAI 的举动遭到了其主要竞争对手 Anthropic 的嘲笑，这使得 OpenAI 的广告成为其首届超级碗活动的焦点。

ChatGPT 广告现已在 40 多个国家/地区推出，OpenAI 表示将于周一在印度、欧洲、中东和北非推出自助服务访问。聊天机器人内的广告针对的是 OpenAI 的 Go 订阅者及其免费套餐，该订阅者占其 10 亿周活跃用户的绝大多数。

OpenAI 周一表示，其广告有明确的标签，不会影响 ChatGPT 的答案。广告商无法访问用户的私人对话。

“我们下一阶段的增长将把 ChatGPT 广告带入更多市场，并引入更多格式、目标、购买选项和衡量功能，”OpenAI 在一份新闻稿中表示。 “我们还将探索企业在 ChatGPT 中以更原生的方式与消费者互动的新方式。”

—CNBC 的 Kate Rooney 对本报告做出了贡献

title: 怡安首席执行官表示，保险经纪公司寻求通过收购竞争对手 USI 来建立“一流的中间市场平台”
content:
保险经纪公司奥安周一宣布，将从私募股权公司 KKR 手中收购竞争对手 USI Insurance Services。

这笔 170 亿美元的交易将由怡安以新债提供资金，预计将在第四季度完成，但需获得监管部门的批准。

首席执行官格雷格·凯斯周一在 CNBC 的“Squawk Box”节目中表示，此次合并将建立“美国顶级保险公司”。

“这意味着我们将能够为服务不足的美国中端市场带来世界一流的解决方案，并……为美国 20 万家中端市场公司及其 4800 万名员工制定客户领导力的新标准，”他说。

Aon 的收购建立在该公司于 2024 年收购 NFP 的基础上，NFP 是另一家专注于中端市场平台的保险经纪公司。美国中型市场。

据宣布此项交易的新闻稿称，USI 是美国第十大保险经纪公司，该公司年收入超过 30 亿美元，拥有超过 10,500 名员工。

交易完成后，USI 首席执行官 Mike Sicard 将接任怡安总裁兼中型市场全球首席执行官。

“加入怡安代表着一个真正充满活力的团队我们公司的新篇章以及作为怡安联合平台一部分加速我们发展势头的机会，”Sicard 在新闻稿中表示。 “我们的公司拥有强大的单一公司文化，并坚定地致力于共同努力，为客户提供最好的能力。”

KKR 合伙人 Chris Harrington 在一份新闻稿中表示，怡安是支持环旭电子下一个增长篇章的理想合作伙伴。

怡安股价在周一盘前交易中下跌约 1%。 但尽管最初业绩下滑，凯斯表示，通过收购，公司现在能够以规模服务中间市场的机会，对股东来说具有巨大的价值潜力。

“这也许是我作为首席执行官 20 年职业生涯中见过的最伟大的一次，”他说。

title: 曼哈顿的豪华租赁市场蓬勃发展，单位每月价格达到10万美元
content:
本文的一个版本首次出现在 CNBC 与 Robert Frank 合作的 Inside Wealth 时事通讯中，该通讯是针对高净值投资者和消费者的每周指南。注册后即可直接收到您的收件箱。

根据经纪人的说法，富裕租房者的激增将曼哈顿的租金推向新纪录。

曼哈顿的中位租金在 7 月份创下了每月 5,000 美元的历史新高。根据 Street Matrix 市场总监 Jonathan Miller 撰写的《真实交易报告》。平均租金较一年前上涨 15%，达到 6,306 美元。

富裕的租户是增长的主要推动力。根据《Real Deal Report》，豪华租金（市场前 10%）的平均价格在过去一年中上涨了 35%，达到每月 17,464 美元。现在豪华租金的平均价格为每平方英尺 121 美元。

通常，租户是那些还买不起的人。在当今的市场上，拥有大量现金可购买的超级富有的纽约人正在选择租房。待售高端房产供应量创历史新低，导致许多人等待出租，直到找到梦想之家。另一些人则对曼哈顿转售价格的下跌或持平感到惊慌，这使得公寓的投资吸引力下降。

Bespoke Real Estate 的劳拉·克莱因 (Laura Klein) 表示：“这些人可以轻松买得起 2000 万美元、5000 万美元的豪宅。”她最近以每月 177,000 美元的价格代理了切尔西一套顶层公寓的租金。 “库存太少了。而且他们不想妥协。”

其他经纪人表示，纽约新兴的高价值第二套住房已导致许多富有的潜在买家转而租房。

“临时住所税公告后租金急剧上涨，表明一些潜在购买者可能已经选择了灵活性而非所有权，”The Corcoran 总裁兼首席执行官 Pam Liebman 表示集团。

富裕的纽约人涌入租赁市场，为大型租赁创造了一个新市场。根据 The Real Deal 的数据，今年迄今为止，月租超过 50,000 美元的公寓数量比 2025 年增加了一倍多，而月租超过 100,000 美元的公寓数量增加了七倍。

Klein 表示，所有超高端租赁都没有公开上市，而是通过高端经纪人的小型网络悄悄向富裕客户提供。她目前在翠贝卡 (Tribeca) 的租金为每月 175,000 美元，在上东区的租金为每月 95,000 美元。

“现在每月 100,000 美元的数字几乎是正常的，”克莱因说。 “这些租户想要交钥匙、独特、奖杯的房产。”

她说，豪华出租屋的业主不需要收入，但考虑到需求，他们会投机取巧。

“他们对我说，‘如果数字正确，我就会出租。’她说，这些房产如果上市，售价将高达数千万美元。

罗伯特·弗兰克 (Robert Frank) 撰写的《内部财富》时事通讯是高净值投资者及其服务行业的每周指南。
